jobs.title_zh: Bennion Center HIVE 项目协调员（勤工助学）
jobs.hours_group: 最低工时 ≤ 10 小时或未提供
jobs.work_study_evidence: must have work-study
jobs.work_schedule_summary_en: Times are determined based on the needs of the Bennion Center, but include mornings, afternoons, nights, and weekends. Selected candidates will be expected to host a weekly meeting for a group of first-year HIVE residents, and must be available for a weekly HIVE leadership meeting that takes place every Tuesday from 1-2 PM
jobs.work_schedule_summary_zh: 工作时间根据Bennion中心的需求确定，但包括上午、下午、晚上和周末。被选中的候选人将被期望为一年级HIVE居民小组主持每周会议，并且必须能够参加每周二下午1-2点举行的HIVE领导会议。
jobs.job_summary_zh:
HIVE（High Impact Volunteer Experience）协调员是 Bennion Center 团队成员，也是在 Kahlert Village HIVE 住宿学习社区中为一年级学生提供示范和指导的同伴导师。该岗位代表 Bennion Center，负责社区参与教育、项目活动和资源连接。

申请人必须具备勤工助学资格，且其他校内工作的总时数每周不得超过 7 小时。
jobs.job_summary_en:
The Bennion Center HIVE (High Impact Volunteer Experience) Coordinator is an integral part of the Bennion Center team and is seen as a role model and mentor for first-year students living in the HIVE living-learning community in Kahlert Village residence hall. This position serves an ambassador to the Bennion Center and is responsible for community engagement eduction, programming, and resource connection. Candidates must have work-study to be eligible for this position.

Selected candidates must not have other employment on campus totaling over 7 hours a week.
jobs.minimum_qualifications_zh: 犹他大学当前在读学生；必须获得本年度联邦勤工俭学资格。
jobs.minimum_qualifications_en:
- Current University of Utah student
- Must be awarded Federal Work Study for the year
jobs.responsibilities_zh:
指导一年级学生，规划社区参与机会，教授围绕社区参与途径的基础课程，在Bennion中心办公室和Kahlert村的Kiosk值班，计划每周HIVE会议，并参加每周HIVE领导团队会议。
- 指导HIVE宿舍楼中的一组一年级学生。
- 为HIVE学生举行每周例会。
- 参加每周HIVE领导团队会议，为每周HIVE会议做准备并履行其他行政职能。
- 学习并促进社区参与途径课程在HIVE学生的定期会议中。
- 在春季和夏季与一年级办公室和空间建立关系，以宣传和招募一年级学生加入HIVE。
- 参加夏季任何有机会与一年级学生互动的迎新活动。
- 与学生参与和外展副主任合作，为HIVE制定申请和面试流程。
- 对HIVE申请人进行预筛选并协助面试。
- 与HIVE宿舍助理合作并沟通。
- 与社区伙伴联系，计划至少一次HIVE学生在周六服务项目或服务角落之夜之外的社区参与机会。
- 参加与副主任的定期会议。
- 参加所有与HIVE合作的周六服务项目。

值班/亭子服务员职责包括：
- 在Gail Miller社区参与塔（位于Kahlert村宿舍楼）的Bennion中心亭子和学生会大楼的Bennion中心办公室担任Bennion中心大使。
- 将感兴趣的学生推荐到适当的Bennion中心项目和校内外社区参与机会。
- 维护亭子和Bennion中心的物资库存和需求。
- 指导临时志愿者可用的服务角落项目。
- 服务员将协助Bennion中心工作人员完成其他文书任务，以帮助实现Bennion中心的使命、愿景和价值观。
- 愿景：通过参与直接服务和其他社区参与（或公民）途径，让学生发现他们的人、热情和目的。
- 使命：Bennion中心的使命是通过提供变革性的社区参与体验来支持学生的福祉和成功，这些体验对学生发展和社区需求产生积极影响。
- 价值观：行动、归属、合作与诚信。

其他职责和期望包括：
- 参加Bennion中心学生领袖迎新。
- 在8月确定的日期为HIVE入住做好准备。
- 与Bennion中心工作人员伙伴保持开放和及时的沟通。
- 满足Bennion中心工作人员伙伴给出的截止日期。
- 使用MyTime系统进行工资发放。
- 可能被提供在Bennion中心学生委员会任职的机会。
jobs.responsibilities_en:
Mentor first-year students, plan community engagement opportunities, teach basic curriculum around pathways to community engagement, work front desk shifts at the Bennion Center office and Kiosk at Kahlert Village, plan weekly HIVE meetings, and attend weekly HIVE leadership team meetings.
- Mentor a group of first year students in the HIVE residence hall.
- Hold a consistent weekly meeting for HIVE students.
- Attend weekly meeting with HIVE leadership team to prepare for weekly HIVE meetings and to meet other administrative functions.
- Learn and facilitate the Pathways to Community Engagement Curriculum to HIVE students in a regular meeting
- Build relationships with First-Year offices and spaces over the preceding spring and summer to advertise to and recruit first-year students for the HIVE .
- Participate in any orientation events over the summer that have opportunities to engage with First-Year students.
- Develop an application and interview process for the HIVE in collaboration with the Associate Director for Student Engagement and Outreach
- Conduct pre-screening of HIVE applicants and assist with interviews.
- Collaborate and communicate with HIVE Resident Advisors
- Connect with community partners to plan at least 1 community engagement opportunity for HIVE students outside of Saturday Service Projects or Service Corner Nites
- Attend regular meeting with the Associate Director
- Attend all Saturday Service Projects in collaboration with the HIVE .

Desk / Kiosk Attendant duties will include:
- Serving as ambassadors for the Bennion Center at the Bennion Center Kiosk at the Gail Miller Community Engagement Tower (located at the Kahlert Village residence hall) and at the Bennion Center office in the student union.
- Referring interested students to the appropriate Bennion Center programs and community engagement opportunities both on and off campus.
- Maintaining inventory of supplies and needs at the kiosk and in the Bennion Center.
- Guiding and instructing drop-in volunteers on available Service Corner projects.
- Attendants will assist Bennion Center staff with other clerical tasks to help meet the
- mission, vision, and values of the Bennion Center.
- VISION : For students to discover their people, passion, and purpose through participation in direct service and other community engagement (or civic) pathways.
- MISSION : The mission of the Bennion Center is to support student well-being and success by providing transformative community engagement experiences that make positive impacts on student development and community needs.
- VALUES : Action, Belonging, Collaboration, & Integrity.

Additional duties and expectations will include:
- Attend Bennion Center Student Leader Orientation
- Being available for HIVE move-in at a determined date in August
- Keep open and timely communication with the Bennion Center Staff Partner
- Meet deadlines given by Bennion Center Staff Partner
- Utilize the MyTime system for payroll
- May be offered a spot to serve on the Bennion Center Student Board
jobs.preferences_zh: 优先考虑具备出色沟通能力、能在最少指导下规划活动和会议，并且有愿望与一年级学生建立联系并合作的候选人。
jobs.preferences_en: Preference for a candidate who has great communication skills, can plan events and meetings with minimal direction, and a desire to connect and work with first-year students.

jobs.hours_group: 最低工时 ≤ 10 小时或未提供
jobs.work_schedule_summary_en: This position is a contracted position. Selected candidate will be contacted when opportunities arrive.
jobs.work_schedule_summary_zh: 该职位为合同制职位。当有机会出现时，将联系被选中的候选人。
jobs.job_summary_zh:
作为团队成员支持 Bennion Center for Community Engagement 的日常运营和各类项目需求。主要负责拍摄照片、编辑照片，并将成片上传到共享网盘。

该岗位按需安排，没有固定工时。录用者需要参加所有周六服务项目、Bennion Center Community Celebration，以及中心负责人指定的其他活动。
jobs.job_summary_en:
Work as part of a collaborative team to support the daily operations and varied programmatic needs of the Bennion Center for Community Engagement at the University of Utah. Primary job responsibilities include the following:
- Taking photographs
- Editing photographs
- Uploading photographs to a shared drive folder

This position will be hired at an as needed basis and does not have regular hours. The person hired in this position will be expected to work all Saturday Service Projects, Bennion Center Community Celebration, and other events determined by the Bennion Center leadership.
jobs.minimum_qualifications_zh: 高中文凭或同等学历；需要有效的口头和书面沟通能力；申请人必须展示出能够履行职位描述中概述的基本职能的潜在能力；有拍摄活动照片的经验，包括头像和抓拍。此职位学生每周工作不得超过19小时。任何其他校内职位必须与招聘经理沟通，以确保不超过每周19小时的标准。
jobs.minimum_qualifications_en:
- High School Diploma, or equivalency.
- Effective verbal and written communication skills are required.
- Applicants must demonstrate the potential ability to perform the essential functionsof the job as outlined in the position description.
- Experience taking photos at events including headshots, and candid shots.
- Students in this role cannot work more than 19 hours a week. Any other on-campus position must be shared with the hiring manager in order to not go over the 19 hours a week standard.
jobs.responsibilities_zh:
- 能够在周六上午的“周六服务项目”活动中拍照。时间不定，但通常在上午8:30至下午12:30之间。这需要在校内外往返。
- 该职位可能被要求在其他日期和时间出席拍照，包括团体照、头像照或特别活动中的抓拍。
- 该职位还将被要求将照片上传至共享驱动器文件夹，并正确命名照片以便于访问。
jobs.responsibilities_en:
- Being available to take photos on Saturday mornings at events called Saturday Service Projects. Time varies, but ranges from 8:30 AM- 12:30 PM. This requires on and off-campus travel.
- This position may be asked to be present to take photos at other days and times throughout the year which may include group photos, headshots, or candid photos at special events.
- This position will also be asked to upload photos to a shared drive folder and properly name the photos for easy access.
jobs.preferences_zh: 具有摄影经验、自我驱动且具备编辑经验的候选人。
jobs.preferences_en: Candidate who has photography experience who is self directed and has experience editing.

jobs.title_zh: 犹他大学学生办公室助理
jobs.department_zh: C 区学业与职业咨询
jobs.department_en: Academic Advising & Career Coaching — Region C
jobs.undergraduate_evidence_zh: 职位明确限定为犹他大学全日制本科生（full-time undergraduate University of Utah students）。
jobs.work_schedule_summary_en: Shifts will be primarily M-F between 8:00a – 5:00p, with an occassional evening or weekend shift with advance notice.
jobs.work_schedule_summary_zh: 班次主要为周一至周五上午8:00至下午5:00之间，偶尔会有晚间或周末班次，会提前通知。
jobs.job_summary_zh:
这是一个不提供福利的兼职岗位，仅面向已正式注册的犹他大学全日制本科生。

本科生教育部门招聘学生办公室助理，为学业咨询和职业辅导办公室提供日常支持。工作包括当面或通过电话接待、协助访客，以及处理一般行政事务。理想人选应主动、成熟、亲和、可靠、适应性强、待人友好，能够与他人合作并具备良好的沟通能力。
jobs.job_summary_en:
THIS IS A PART - TIME , NON - BENEFITED POSITION OPEN TO MATRICULATED , FULL - TIME UNDERGRADUATE UNIVERSITY OF UTAH STUDENTS .

Undergraduate Studies is committed to creating opportunities to create meaningful impacts through transformative undergraduate experiences. To assist undergraduate students in building professional skills and knowledge, we are hiring part-time Student Office Assistants to greet and assist visitors in person or over the telephone and provide general office support to academic advising and career coaching offices. We are looking forward to working with people who have the following personal attributes: initiative, maturity, approachability, dependability, flexibility, friendliness, ability to work well with others and strong communication skills.
jobs.minimum_qualifications_zh: 该职位为兼职、无福利岗位，面向犹他大学注册的全日制本科生开放；每周至少到岗工作 12 小时，最多 20 小时；能够保守机密信息；具备主动性、成熟度、亲和力、可靠性、灵活性、友善、良好的团队合作能力和较强的沟通能力。
jobs.responsibilities_zh:
- 接待、问候来访者，并将其引导至相应的人员或办公室。
- 接听电话，提供帮助，并将学生和访客引导至正确的人员或办公室。
- 每周至少到岗工作12小时，最多20小时（面对面工作）。
- 能够保守机密信息。
- 帮助学生安排预约，并根据需要安排会议。引导学生使用适当的资源。
- 与学术顾问或职业教练紧密合作，协助他们完成任务。
- 协助处理一般办公室事务，包括文字处理、数据录入和互联网搜索。
- 报告部门空间内的任何问题；根据需要安排服务电话。
- 愿意根据需要扩展此角色并承担新的职责。
jobs.responsibilities_en:
- Receives, greets and directs visitors to appropriate person or office.
- Answers telephones, providing assistance and directing students and guests to the correct person or office.
- Available to work in person a minimum of 12 and a maximum of 20 in-person hours per week.
- Ability to keep confidential information.
- Helps students to schedule appointments and arranges for meetings, as needed. Direct students to appropriate resources.
- Work closely with and assist academic advisors or career coaches in their assignments.
- Assists with general office needs, including word processing, data entry and internet searches.
- Report any issues within the departmental space; arranges for service calls as needed.
- Be willing to expand this role and take on new responsibilities as needed.
jobs.preferences_zh:
- 犹他大学在读本科生，熟悉犹他大学的政策、程序和系统。
- 具有强烈的职业道德，优秀的写作和创造性解决问题的能力。
- 能够向不同人群传达复杂信息，同时保持卓越的客户服务。
- 在处理敏感和机密的学生信息时具有明智的判断力。
- 能够独立工作，也能作为团队的一员工作，并能与大学各级同事保持积极、协作的工作关系。
- 有使用Microsoft Office的经验。
jobs.preferences_en:
- A current University of Utah undergraduate student with familiarity with University of Utah policies, procedures and systems.
- Strong work ethic, with excellent writing and creative problems-solving skills.
- Be able to relay complex information to a variety of people while maintaining excellent customer service.
- Sound judgment in handling sensitive and confidential student information.
- Able to work both independently and part of a team and able to maintain positive and collaborative working relationships with colleagues at all levels of the University.
- Experience with Microsoft Office.

jobs.department_zh: Huntsman 癌症研究所·Chandrasekharan 实验室
jobs.job_summary_zh:
在首席研究员监督下完成实验技术操作。工作包括从酵母或哺乳动物细胞培养物制备细胞裂解液，开展分子生物学实验，配制培养基并维护实验室耗材库存。

Huntsman Cancer Institute 的服务范围包括 Idaho、Montana、Nevada、Utah 和 Wyoming，工作涉及癌症预防、治疗和康复。申请人可在求职信或面试中说明自己的研究、预防、临床照护、社区参与、培训、行政等经历如何支持该机构的工作。
jobs.job_summary_en:
Performs laboratory techniques and experiments under the supervision of the principal investigator. Prepares cell lysates from yeast or mammalian cultures, performs molecular biology techniques, prepares growth media and maintains stock of lab consumables.

_Huntsman Cancer Institute is committed to cancer prevention, care, and survivorship for all communities within the area we serve – which includes Idaho, Montana, Nevada, Utah, and Wyoming – with impact worldwide._

_In your cover letter or during your interview process, we invite you to share how your professional experiences have prepared you to serve as a member of our team as we work to reduce the cancer burden experienced by all people and communities. This may include description of your prior experiences related to research, prevention, clinical care, community engagement/outreach, training, administration, or other areas relevant to Huntsman Cancer Institute’s mission and this position._
jobs.minimum_qualifications_zh: 此为入门级职位，提供在职培训。要求能够理解并执行口头和书面指示；能够保持准确记录；具备良好的人际关系和有效沟通能力。
jobs.minimum_qualifications_en:
This is an entry level position and on the job training is provided. The ability to understand and carry out verbal and written instructions; the ability to keep accurate records; and demonstrated human relations and effective communication skills required.

A general knowledge of laboratory procedures, equipment and terminology; the ability to operate and care for laboratory equipment; and a knowledge of appropriate specimen handling techniques preferred.

Applicants must demonstrate the potential ability to perform the essential functions of the job as outlined in the position description.
jobs.responsibilities_zh:
- 制备酵母或哺乳动物细胞裂解物和生长培养基。(35%)
- 协助首席研究员进行核酸或蛋白质的分离和纯化(10%)
- 执行分子和细胞生物学技术：PCR、免疫荧光和免疫印迹
- 维护实验室无菌微量离心管、培养管、吸头及复制铺布布的库存(35%)
- 保持准确详细的实验记录(10%)

此职位描述并非旨在包含或解释为对分配给该职位的员工所需的所有职责、责任和资格的全面清单。

工作环境和可能要求的频率：

几乎持续：办公室环境。

经常：传染病、油类（_有空气或皮肤接触油类或其他切削液_）、危险（_包括各种物理条件，如靠近移动机械部件、移动车辆、电流、在高处或脚手架上工作，或接触化学品_）。

很少：接触动物。

身体要求和可能要求的频率：

几乎持续：听力、倾听、说话。

经常：重复性手部动作（如打字）、行走、站立、坐着。

很少：弯腰、伸手过头。
jobs.responsibilities_en:
- Prepares yeast or mammalian cell lysates and growth media. (35%)
- Assists the Principal Investigator in nucleic acid or protein isolation and purification (10%)
- Performs molecular and cell biology techniques: PCR , immunofluorescence and immunoblotting
- Maintains laboratory stocks of sterile microfuge tubes, culture tubes, tips and replica-plating cloth (35%)
- Maintains accurate and detailed experimental records (10%)

This job description is not designed to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities and qualifications required of employees assigned to the job.

Work Environment and Level of Frequency that may be required:

Nearly Continuously: Office environment.

Often: Infectious disease, oils ( _there is air or skin exposure to oils or other cutting fluids_ ), hazards ( _includes a variety of physical conditions, such as proximity to moving mechanical parts, moving vehicles, electrical current, working on scaffolding and high places, or exposure to chemicals_ ).

Seldom: Exposure to animals.

Physical Requirements and Level of Frequency that may be required

Nearly Continuously: Hearing, listening, talking.

Often: Repetitive hand motion (such as typing), walking, standing, sitting.

Seldom: Bending, reaching overhead.
jobs.preferences_zh:
- 拥有生物学、生物化学或其他同等科学学科的本科学位。
- 有实验室经验者优先。
- 展现出团队合作精神、较强的组织能力和有效的沟通能力。
- 对发现和将研究成果应用于人类健康有高度积极性。
- 熟悉实验室操作流程以及生物学和化学的基本概念。
- 能够履行职位描述中概述的基本工作职能。
- 我们的实验室以勤奋工作和创新发现为原则。成功的候选人将认同这些价值观。
- 高度积极、有内在好奇心、愿意学习、注重细节、可靠且时间灵活。
- 强烈鼓励拥有本科学位（主修生物学或相关领域）并希望获得实验室经验以继续攻读研究生或医学院的学生申请。
jobs.preferences_en:
- Bachelor’s degree with Biology, Biochemistry or other equivalent scientific discipline as the major.
- Previous laboratory experience is highly preferred.
- Demonstrated team orientation, strong organizational skills and effective communication skills.
- Highly motivated toward discovery and application of findings to human health.
- Good working knowledge of lab procedures and the basic concepts in Biology and Chemistry.
- Ability to perform the essential functions of the job as outlined in the position description.
- Our laboratory is grounded on the principle of hard work and innovative discoveries. The successful candidate will share these values.
- Highly motivated, intrinsically curious and willing to learn, detail oriented, reliable and flexible with time.
- Students with Bachelor degree (majoring in Biology or related areas) and seeking lab experience to pursue graduate or medical school are strongly encouraged to apply.

jobs.title_zh: 兼职社交媒体内容助理
jobs.experience_evidence: 1 year of higher education can be substituted for 1 year of directly related work experience; 4 years of directly related work experience). - requires at least 1 year of related experience
jobs.work_schedule_summary_en: 19 hours per week
jobs.work_schedule_summary_zh: 每周19小时
jobs.job_summary_zh:
KUER 招聘一名有创意、注重细节的社交媒体助理，每周工作 19 小时，帮助扩大数字平台受众并提高互动。该入门岗位适合对媒体、新闻、传播或数字营销感兴趣的在校生、应届毕业生或职业起步阶段的求职者。

主要工作是协助制作、排期和监测各社交媒体渠道的内容，让受众更方便地了解 KUER 的新闻、节目和机构使命。
jobs.job_summary_en:
KUER is seeking a creative and detail-oriented Social Media Assistant for 19 hours a week to help grow and engage our audiences across digital platforms. This entry-level position is ideal for a student, recent graduate, or early-career professional interested in media, journalism, communications or digital marketing.

The Social Media Assistant will support the creation, scheduling and monitoring of content across social media channels, helping connect audiences with our news, programs and mission.

Learn more about the great benefits of working for University of Utah: benefits.utah.edu

The department may choose to hire at any of the below job levels and associated pay rates based on their business need and budget.
jobs.minimum_qualifications_zh: 等效声明：1年高等教育可替代1年直接相关工作经验（例如：学士学位=4年直接相关工作经验）。要求至少1年相关经验。部门特定资格：高中文凭或同等学历；鼓励当前大学生和近期毕业生申请；较强的书面沟通能力和注重细节；熟悉主要社交媒体平台及其最佳实践；能够管理多项任务并满足截止日期；对公共媒体、新闻、社区参与和讲故事有热情；基本的摄影和智能手机视频技能；能够独立工作和协作；热衷于以社区为中心的讲故事和受众参与。
jobs.minimum_qualifications_en:
EQUIVALENCY STATEMENT : 1 year of higher education can be substituted for 1 year of directly related work experience (Example: bachelor’s degree = 4 years of directly related work experience).
- Requires at least 1 year of related experience.

Department Specific Qualifications:

jobs.job_summary_en:
Joining an upper-tier IT team, this role involves assisting in the administration of Apple and Microsoft systems and their supporting infrastructure to meet the needs of students, staff, and teaching requirements at a central campus hub. While experience and knowledge in specific Apple, Microsoft, and Information Technology areas are advantageous, training and mentorship will be provided to help applicants develop advanced skills and knowledge.

To facilitate accurate monitoring of work hours, part-time employees are generally requested to limit their University of Utah employment to Library positions only, unless exceptions are granted.
jobs.minimum_qualifications_zh: 加入高级 IT 团队，协助管理 Apple 和 Microsoft 系统及其支持基础设施，以满足中心校园枢纽的学生、员工和教学需求；虽然具备特定 Apple、Microsoft 和信息技术领域的经验和知识是有利的，但将提供培训和指导以帮助申请人发展高级技能和知识。
jobs.responsibilities_zh: 职责包括协助学生、教师和员工解决与Apple和Microsoft相关的问题，如软件和硬件故障排除、系统维修和更换。通过问题工单系统、会议、消息和电子邮件响应软件或硬件问题。使用各种方法管理系统上的软件安装，包括手动安装、AppsAnywhere、Microsoft System Center Configuration Manager (SCCM) 和 Jamf Pro。其他任务包括擦除、测试、映像和部署团队管理的校园实验室和地点的系统，以及主管根据专业知识和需求分配的各种项目和任务。
jobs.responsibilities_en: Responsibilities include assisting students, faculty, and staff with Apple and Microsoft-related issues, such as software and hardware troubleshooting, system repairs, and replacements. Responding to software or hardware issues through problem ticket systems, meetings, messaging, and email. Managing software installations on systems using various methods, including manual installation, AppsAnywhere, Microsoft System Center Configuration Manager ( SCCM ), and Jamf Pro. Additional tasks include erasing, testing, imaging, and deploying systems across campus labs and locations managed by the team, as well as various projects and tasks assigned by the supervisor based on expertise and demand.
jobs.preferences_zh:
- 目前就读于犹他大学，在秋季和春季学期至少注册6个本科学分或5个研究生学分。
- 申请人需要具备解决复杂问题的能力，并与我们的团队合作实施有弹性、可扩展且持久的解决方案。
- 申请人还必须能在独立和团队环境中有效工作。
- 理想的候选人应展现出持续独立及通过团队合作解决复杂问题的能力。
- 精通Apple和Microsoft生态系统中的软件部署和系统管理。
- 熟练使用Jamf Pro和Microsoft System Center Configuration Manager（SCCM）等工具，并具备Bash、PowerShell、Python等脚本或软件开发技能，以及C或C++等低级语言。
- 具有技术支持、培训、演示和针对不同受众编写文档的经验者优先。
- 熟悉硬件基础知识，并了解Linux等其他操作系统及多平台环境将有所帮助。
jobs.preferences_en:
- Current University of Utah student enrolled in at least 6 undergraduate credit hours or 5 graduate credit hours during the fall and spring semesters.
- The applicant will need the ability to troubleshoot complex problems and work with our group to implement resilient, scalable, and durable solutions.
- Applicants must also work effectively independently and in team settings.
- Ideal candidates demonstrate a continuously demonstrated ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex issues individually and through teamwork.
- Excellent knowledge of software deployment and systems management in an Apple and Microsoft ecosystem.
- Proficiency in tools such as Jamf Pro and Microsoft System Center Configuration Manager ( SCCM ), with scripting or software development skills in languages such as Bash, PowerShell, Python, and low-level languages like C or C++.
- Experience in technical support, training, presenting, and creating documentation tailored to distinct audiences is desirable.
- Familiarity with hardware fundamentals and knowledge of other operating systems such as Linux and multi-platform environments is helpful.

岗位需要一名重视服务、有条理、适应性强的工作人员，协助成人课程、工作坊、讲座和外联活动。需要与花园员工、志愿者、来宾和外聘讲师合作，并在活动当天负责场地布置、来宾接待与签到、讲师及志愿者支持、现场问题处理和清理工作。

our mission of connecting people with plants and the beauty of living landscapes through

various educational programming! Experience and work with experts in a wide range of programs including wellness, creative expressions, horticulture, ecology, and culinary arts.

We are looking for customer-service minded, organized, and adaptable individual to help with adult classes, workshops, lectures, and outreach. This position will be responsible being the point person for day of set up, guest greeting and check-in, instructor and volunteer support, troubleshooting, clean up, etc. for all adult programs.

Learn more about the great benefits of working for University of Utah: benefits.utah.edu

jobs.responsibilities_zh:
- 作为指定课程、工作坊和讲座的负责人，包括在核心员工工作时间之外使用独立的问题解决能力进行故障排除，并在项目目标内确定优先级。
- 与讲师、嘉宾、志愿者和员工协调，确保体验顺畅。
- 负责项目的设置和清理工作，包括举起和移动重达50磅的物品，在崎岖不平的岩石地形、楼梯和斜坡路径上行走。
- 根据需要处理项目中的事件、问题和设施清洁。
- 向项目经理汇报项目的成功、关切、需求和潜在变化。
- 驾驶花园推车或电车用于课堂设置和学生无障碍交通。
- 以专业的方式代表花园、我们的使命和大学与客人、讲师、志愿者、员工和合作伙伴互动。
- 每周协助与志愿者沟通分配的任务/工作。
- 帮助客人注册项目。
- 协助数据收集和系统流程。
- 协助供应品库存和组织。
- 协助创建网站列表并维护更新和更改。
- 协助外展摆摊和其他活动。
- 定期与经理开会，偶尔参加部门范围的会议。
- 协助分配的其他项目和职责。

此职位描述并非旨在包含或解释为分配给该职位的员工所需的所有职责、责任和资格的全面清单。

工作环境和通常需要的频率或水平

经常：教室环境、花园/户外环境、储藏室和工具室、活动空间、公共空间

偶尔：停车场、校园区域

身体要求和可能需要的频率水平

经常：站立、坐着、倾听、交谈、行走（有时在丘陵、崎岖的地形上）、驾驶电车、弯腰、伸手过头、重复手部动作（如打字）、举起和搬运重达50磅的物品、设置教室空间
jobs.responsibilities_en:
- Be the point person for assigned classes, workshops, and lectures, including troubleshooting using independent problem-solving outside of core staff hours and prioritizing within program goals.
- Coordinate with instructor, guests, volunteers and staff to ensure a streamlined experience.
- Set up and clean up for programming, including lifting and moving up to 50 pounds, navigating uneven, rocky terrain, stairs, and inclined paths.
- Handle incidents, issues, and facility clean-up for programming as needed.
- Report back to Program Manager on program success, concerns, needs, and potential changes.
- Drive garden carts or trams for class set-up and student accessibility transport.
- Represent the garden, our mission, and university professionally with guests, instructors, volunteers, staff, and partners.
- Assist in communicating with volunteers weekly regarding assigned duties/tasks
- Help with registering guests for programs
- Assist with data collection and system processes
- Assist with supply inventory and organization
- Assist with creating website listings and maintaining updates and changes.
- Assist with outreach tabling and other events
- Attend regular meetings with manager, occasionally attend department-wide meetings
- Assist with other projects and duties as assigned

This job description is not designed to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities and qualifications required of employees assigned to the job.

Work Environment and level or Frequency typically required

Often: Classroom environment, Garden/Outdoor environment, Storage and tool rooms, Event spaces, Public spaces

Seldom: parking lots, campus areas

Physical Requirements and level of frequency that may be required

Often: standing, sitting, listening, talking, walking (sometimes on hilly, uneven terrain), driving trams, bending, reaching overhead, repetitive hand motion (such as typing), lifting and carrying up to 50 lbs., setting up classroom spaces

jobs.job_summary_zh:
协助 Red Butte Garden 露天剧场的户外音乐会和部分活动完成搭建、撤场和维护。岗位没有固定班次，每周排班随活动和音乐会安排变化。活动季为 5 月至 10 月，单次班次通常为 8 至 12 小时，需要早班、晚班和周末工作，预计 5 月中旬入职。

福利包括 UTA 公交通行证、免费花园会员、课程和礼品店折扣，以及两张年度 Summer Concert Series 门票。Red Butte Garden 可从 Research Park、University Medical Center 的多条公交线路或 Trax 红线换乘抵达，也可使用校园 Sunnyside Route 按需班车。
jobs.job_summary_en:
Red Butte Garden is looking for candidates to assist with the setup, breakdown, and maintenance for all outdoor concerts and select events in Red Butte Garden’s Amphitheatre. The position does not have a regular work shift, and exact schedule will vary weekly depending on event and concert schedules. Concert and event season is from May through October and will typically require an 8 – 12-hour shift. Morning, evening, and weekend shifts are required. Anticipated start date is mid-May.

We offer:
- The opportunity to work at a beautiful botanic garden and engage with a plant-loving community!
- Benefits such as a UTA bus pass, free garden membership, discounts for RBG classes, discounts in the gift shop, and two tickets to the annual Summer Concert Series.
- A supportive and respectful workplace that values cooperation, compassion, and diversity.

Red Butte Garden is accessible via several bus routes that stop in Research Park and at the University Medical Center, as well as the Trax Red line, followed by a short walk or on-demand university campus shuttle. The campus shuttle offers a direct line to Red Butte Garden via the Sunnyside Route.
- https://commuterservices.utah.edu/uta/
- https://commuterservices.utah.edu/campus-shuttle/
- https://www.redbuttegarden.org/directions/

Learn more about the great benefits of working for University of Utah: benefits.utah.edu

- Valid alcohol server certification/license (as required by state law).
- Strong interpersonal and communication skills with an emphasis on customer service.

- Must be available to work nights, weekends, and holidays, as scheduled per event needs.

- 遵守所有工作场所安全政策和体育场活动规程。
jobs.responsibilities_en:

- Verify customer age and identification in accordance with state alcohol laws.
- Process payments efficiently using a point-of-sale ( POS ) system.
- Maintain a clean and organized service area, ensuring compliance with health and safety regulations.
- Adhere to responsible alcohol service guidelines, recognizing signs of overconsumption and refusing service when necessary.
- Provide friendly, professional customer service, ensuring a positive guest experience.
- Work efficiently in a high-volume setting, handling large crowds and long lines.
- Assist with setup, stocking, and closing duties as needed.
- Comply with all workplace safety policies and stadium event protocols.

jobs.responsibilities_zh: 按照既定的方法、标准和程序，从柜台和蒸汽餐台向自助餐厅/小吃店顾客提供各种食品，确保分配适当的份量，并提供及时、优质的服务。准备各种食品，如三明治、沙拉、装饰菜、新鲜水果和生蔬菜，为顾客和厨师提供日常服务，并完成餐饮订单。通过包装未使用的部分并将需要冷藏的物品放入冰箱，确保新鲜食品得到妥善保管。清洁和消毒工作区域，如台面、咖啡机、热巧克力机和果汁机，以及切片机、秤、冰箱和货架，确保准备和供应食品的区域卫生。使用秤和电动切片机等设备，为餐饮订单和自助餐切片和称量肉类、奶酪等。刮除、分类和预冲洗脏的餐具、玻璃杯和银器；将其放入洗碗机；取出干净的物品并将其送到各个用餐区，以提供日常服务使用的卫生餐具。
jobs.responsibilities_en: Sets-up and serves a variety of food items from counters and steam tables to cafeteria/snack shop patrons by following established methods, standards and procedures to ensure appropriate sized portions are distributed, and to provide prompt, quality service. Prepares various food items, such as sandwiches, salads, garnishes, fresh fruits and raw vegetables to provide daily service to patrons and cooks, and to complete catering orders. Ensures fresh food is properly cared for by wrapping unused portions and refrigerating those items requiring cold storage. Cleans and sanitizes work areas, such as counter tops, coffee, hot chocolate and juice machines, as well as slicers, scales, refrigerators and shelves to ensure a sanitary area for the preparation and serving of food. Uses equipment, such as scales and electric slicing machines to slice and weigh meat, cheese, etc. for catering orders and buffets. Scrapes, sorts and pre-rinses soiled dishware, glasses, and silverware; places them in the dishwashing machine; removes clean items and delivers them to various dining areas to provide sanitary dishes for use in daily serving.

jobs.responsibilities_zh:
在高层次上，职责可能包括：
- 支持手持POS设备（PAX A900）和Shift4平台，随着我们的发展。
- 对所有设备进行例行检查，包括测试交易、设备功能和菜单准确性。
- 存储和组织设备，并协调线缆/配件。
- 协助POS网络的有线和无线连接，包括理解预期的VLAN和IP范围。
- 支持移动点餐工作流程，包括设备通过网络与打印机通信。
- 维护和排除用于酒精合规的ID扫描仪故障（目前有40多台在运行）。
- 管理并部署各售货亭的数字菜单板，包括向特定显示器推送更新，并在活动前验证准确性。
- 在活动期间，响应收银机/设备问题并进行故障排除。

除了技术职责外，该角色还需要：
- 在实时活动中积极主动且有前瞻性。
- 能够在高压情况下快速排除故障。
- 对设备和问题跟踪高度有条理。
- 能够舒适地与售货亭工作人员沟通，并在需要时升级问题。

该职位将支持我们场馆的所有大型活动，包括足球、篮球（MBB / WBB）、体操、垒球、棒球、足球、长曲棍球、冰球、音乐会和其他特别活动。
jobs.responsibilities_en:
At a high level, responsibilities could include:
- Supporting handheld POS devices ( PAX A900) and the Shift4 platform as we move forward.
- Perform routine checkups on all devices, including testing transactions, device function, and menu accuracy.
- Storage and organization of devices and coordinating cords/accessories.
- Assisting with wired and wireless connectivity across the POS network, including understanding expected VLANs and IP ranges.
- Supporting mobile ordering workflows, including devices communicating across the network to printers.
- Maintaining and troubleshooting ID scanners used for alcohol compliance (we currently have 40+ in operation).
- Managing and deploying digital menu boards across concession stands, including pushing updates to specific displays and verifying accuracy prior to events.
- During events, respond to register/device issues and troubleshoot.

In addition to the technical responsibilities, this role is:
- Proactive and forward-thinking during live events.
- Able to troubleshoot quickly in high-pressure situations.
- Highly organized with equipment and issue tracking.
- Comfortable communicating with concessions staff and escalating issues when needed.

This position would support all major events across our venues, including football, basketball ( MBB / WBB ), gymnastics, softball, baseball, soccer, lacrosse, hockey, concerts, and other special events.

UtahPresents Box Office, located in Kingsbury Hall, is responsible for ticketing and customer service operations for UtahPresents, as well as all events at Kingsbury Hall, Libby Gardner Hall, and Marriott Center for Dance.

The UtahPresents Box Office staff creates a welcoming environment for patrons in person, on the phone, and via email. Our staff will have a familiarity of all events, their content, and target audience. - 能够在长时间轮班期间（包括装台和拆台）持续站立、行走和移动。
- 能够弯腰、下跪、蹲下、伸手过头顶，并执行其他体力要求高的任务。
- 能够在多变的环境中工作，包括黑暗空间、嘈杂环境和温度波动。
- 具备足够的视力和听力，以安全操作和评估生产设备。
- 能够在高压或紧急情况下快速有效地做出反应。
- 能够灵活且延长工作时间，包括晚间、周末和节假日。

此描述涵盖核心职责，但并非该角色所有相关责任的详尽列表。
jobs.responsibilities_en:
- Arrive on time and prepared for all assigned shifts.
- Perform tasks such as hanging soft goods, lighting focus, cable wrapping, and truck un-loading/ loading.
- Follow instructions and receive specific training as required for each event. Ask questions and follow through on all assigned tasks.
- Demonstrate effective communication skills and foster a collaborative team environment.
- Adapt to a varied theatre schedule, including nights, weekends, and holidays.
- Complete additional duties as assigned.

Physical Abilities:
- Ability to repeatedly lift, carry, push, or pull up to 50 pounds.
- Ability to stand, walk, and move continuously during long shifts, including load-ins and load-outs.
- Ability to bend, kneel, stoop, reach overhead, and perform other physically demanding tasks.
- Ability to work in varied environments, including dark spaces, loud environments, and fluctuating temperatures.
- Adequate vision and hearing to operate and evaluate production equipment safely.
- Ability to respond quickly and effectively in high-pressure or emergency situations.
- Ability to work flexible and extended hours, including evenings, weekends, and holidays.

This description covers core duties but is not exhaustive of all responsibilities associated with the role.
jobs.special_instructions_zh:
申请时，请准备一份简历和求职信。求职信无需冗长或正式，但应包含您对该职位感兴趣的原因、您希望在该职位上如何成长，以及您能为团队协作环境带来何种态度和技能。

我们很高兴扩展后台团队，并期待与符合条件的候选人进一步讨论该职位。如有其他问题，请联系制作经理rosemary.jones@utah.edu。
jobs.special_instructions_en:
To apply, please prepare a resume and cover letter. Your cover letter does not need to be lengthy or formal but should include why you are interested in the position, how you hope to grow in this position, and what kind of attitude and skills you bring to a team-focused environment.

We are excited to expand our backstage team and look forward to discussing the role in further detail with qualified candidates. For additional questions, please reach the Production Manager at rosemary.jones@utah.edu

jobs.job_summary_zh:
Wilkes 气候科学与政策中心招聘一名学生大使，代表中心并帮助建立活跃的校园社区。每周工作约 10 至 15 小时，负责外联、学生参与、活动、招募和传播，并为来访者介绍中心情况。

适合对气候科学、可持续发展、领导力和社区参与有热情的学生。申请人应可靠、有条理，能够与不同人群沟通，并愿意帮助学生了解 Wilkes 中心的项目和机会。
jobs.job_summary_en:
The Wilkes Center for Climate Science & Policy is seeking a student Wilkes Ambassador to represent the Center and help build an engaged campus community. Working approximately 10–15 hours per week, the Ambassador will support outreach, student engagement, events, recruitment, and communications while serving as a welcoming and knowledgeable representative of the Wilkes Center.

This position is ideal for a student who is enthusiastic about climate science, sustainability, leadership, and community engagement. The Ambassador should be reliable, organized, comfortable interacting with a variety of audiences, and excited to help connect students with Wilkes Center programs and opportunities.
jobs.minimum_qualifications_zh: 具备较强的人际交往和沟通能力；对气候、可持续性、研究或公共服务感兴趣；可靠、有条理，能独立工作和团队合作。
jobs.minimum_qualifications_en:
- Strong interpersonal and communication skills
- Interest in climate, sustainability, research, or public service
- Dependable, organized, and comfortable working independently and on a team
jobs.responsibilities_zh:
1. 在校园活动和外展活动中，担任威尔克斯中心的学生代表和大使。

2. 协助规划、推广和支持威尔克斯中心的项目和 student engagement 活动。

3. 欢迎潜在学生、访客和活动参与者，同时分享有关威尔克斯中心机会的信息。

4. 帮助招募学生参加威尔克斯学者、创新项目和其他中心倡议。

5. 协助活动后勤、注册、布置和参与者互动。

6. 根据需要，通过社交媒体、摄影或活动亮点支持沟通。

7. 收集参与者的反馈，并帮助识别改进项目的机会。

8. 专业地代表威尔克斯中心，并帮助营造一个欢迎的社区，同时维护中心和大学的使命。
jobs.responsibilities_en:
1. Serve as a student representative and ambassador for the Wilkes Center at campus events and outreach activities.

2. Assist with planning, promoting, and supporting Wilkes Center programs and student engagement events.

3. Welcome prospective students, visitors, and event participants while sharing information about Wilkes Center opportunities.

4. Help recruit students for Wilkes Scholars, Innovation programs, and other Center initiatives.

5. Assist with event logistics, registration, setup, and participant engagement.

6. Support communications through social media, photography, or event highlights as needed.

7. Gather feedback from participants and help identify opportunities to improve programming.

8. Represent the Wilkes Center professionally and help foster a welcoming community while upholding the mission of the Center and the University.
jobs.preferences_zh: 有学生组织、外展或活动支持经验者优先，但非必需

jobs.job_summary_zh: Wilkes 气候科学与政策中心招聘一名勤工助学学生，每周工作 10 至 15 小时，协助创意内容制作。主要任务是配合社区参与和传播经理制作播客、为社交媒体制作视频素材，并管理用于市场推广和传播的社交媒体账号。
jobs.job_summary_en: The Wilkes Center for Climate Science & Policy is seeking a work study student to assist with creative content production, 10~15 hours per week. This person will help the Wilkes Center Community Engagement and Communications Manager with producing a podcast, creating video assets for social media, and managing social media channels for marketing and communications purposes.
jobs.minimum_qualifications_zh: 需要具备与气候变化影响、预测和潜在解决方案相关的科学研究与工程的一般知识和熟悉度；具备数字音频和/或视频编辑经验者优先，但非必需；要求可靠、勤奋、注重细节；理想情况下应具备使用数字软件制作和分发创意内容的经验，并对学习气候变化相关研究和叙事感兴趣。
jobs.minimum_qualifications_en: This position requires some general knowledge and familiarity with scientific research and engineering relating to climate change impacts, forecasting, and potential solutions. Some experience with digital audio and/or video editing is desired but not required. We are seeking someone reliable, and diligent, and who pays close attention to detail. This person should ideally have both experience using digital software for making and distributing creative content and an interest in learning about current research relating to climate change and storytelling. This position could be ideal for someone wanting to expand their skill set with environmental journalism or science communications.
jobs.responsibilities_zh:
1. 对指定项目的材料进行深入研究。从所有可用来源收集指定主题的信息，并准确、易懂地汇编信息。

2. 协助每周活动和项目的日程安排。收集、组织和协调各种项目所需的材料。

3. 可能为音频或视频制作撰写脚本和内部脚本片段的草稿。

4. 可能协助搭建和/或拆除录制制作。

5. 可能负责将文本和图形格式化为网页或社交媒体的模板。

6. 可能协助制作和/或发布和设计用于网页或社交媒体的营销材料。

7. 确保已完成全面彻底的研究，并确保制作中使用最佳信息。

8. 确保制作满足公众需求，并维护部门和大学的形象。
jobs.responsibilities_en:
1. Performs in-depth research of materials for prescribed projects. Gathers information from all available sources on assigned topics and compiles the information accurately and understandably.

2. Assists in weekly scheduling of events and projects. Gathers, organizes and coordinates materials needed for various programs.

3. May write drafts of scripts and inner script segments for audio or video production.

4. May assist with setting up and/or taking down recording productions.

5. May be responsible for formatting text and graphics into templates for webs or social media.

6. May assist in production and/or publication and design of marketing materials for web or social media.

7. Ensures that complete and thorough research has been performed and that the best information is being used for a production.

8. Ensures that productions meet the needs of the public and that the image of the department and University are upheld.

jobs.responsibilities_zh:
1. 清扫、清洁、拖地、擦洗和除尘地板。

2. 清洁马桶、洗手盆、淋浴间、浴缸，并擦洗墙壁；使用适当的清洁用品对家具、固定装置、门及相关陈设进行除尘、清洁和吸尘。

3. 操作和维护电动地板机、扫雪机、工业吸尘器、地毯清洗设备和室内装潢清洗设备。

4. 清洁、重新打磨和维护各种地板覆盖物。

5. 标记并移除感染性废物袋和容器。

6. 将保管用品和设备往返于储藏区和工作区之间。

7. 更换利器容器，运输垃圾和废弃物，移除空箱子并整理壁橱。

8. 可能根据需要移动轻便且易于移动的家具和必要物品，以便正确清洁其后方、下方和周围，并在清洁后将所有物品放回原位。

工作环境和可能需要的频率级别

几乎持续：办公室环境。

很少：危险（_包括各种物理条件，如靠近移动机械部件、移动车辆、电流、在高处或脚手架上工作，或接触化学品）。_

身体要求和可能需要的频率级别

几乎持续：坐、听、倾听、说话、行走。

经常：弯腰、伸手过头、扭转。

很少：举起——最多50磅，跪、蹲。
jobs.responsibilities_en:
1. Sweeps, cleans, mops, scrubs and dusts floors.

2. Cleans toilets, basins, showers, bathtubs, and scrubs walls; dusts, cleans and vacuums furniture, fixtures doors and related furnishings by using appropriate cleaning supplies.

3. Operates and maintains electric floor machines, snow blowers, industrial vacuums, carpet shampooing equipment and upholstery shampooing equipment.

4. Cleans, refinishes and maintains a variety of floor coverings.

5. Labels and removes infectious waste bags and containers.

6. Transports custodial supplies and equipment to and from storage and work areas.

7. Replaces sharp containers, transports trash and refuse, removes empty boxes and organizes closets.

8. May move light and easily moveable furniture and necessary items as needed to properly clean behind, underneath, and around them and returns all items to their original position after cleaning.
- This job description is not designed to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities and qualifications required of employees assigned to the job.

Work Environment and Level of Frequency that may be required

Nearly Continuously: Office environment.

Seldom: Hazards ( _includes a variety of physical conditions, such as proximity to moving mechanical parts, moving vehicles, electrical current, working on scaffolding and high places, or exposure to chemicals)._

Physical Requirements and Level of Frequency that may be required

Nearly Continuously: Sitting, hearing, listening, talking, walking.

Often: Bending, reaching overhead, twisting.

Seldom: Lifting – up to 50 pounds, kneeling, squatting.

jobs.job_summary_en:
The purpose of the Housing Ambassador (HA) position is to serve as a frontline representative of the University of Utah’s Housing and Dining Programs ( HDP ). HAs provide exceptional customer service to residents, guests, and university staff while supporting housing operations, promoting HDP resources, and upholding the department’s values of staff excellence, professional growth, integrity, collaboration or teamwork instead, service, and positive attitude.

As student staff members, Housing Ambassadors play a key role in maintaining a welcoming, professional, and efficient environment that supports student success and community engagement within the University of Utah residential communities.
jobs.minimum_qualifications_zh: 必须是犹他大学在读学生；在学术、财务和行为方面与犹他大学保持良好的关系；最低GPA要求：2.0，并在整个就业期间保持；客户服务和文书经验；有在犹他大学校园居住的经验。

jobs.responsibilities_zh:
1. 客户服务与前台支持
- 为学生、家庭和访客提供高水平、友好且信息丰富的客户服务。
- 专业且高效地回复与住房相关的电子邮件和电话。
- 了解HDP政策、住房流程、入住/退房时间表以及FERPA法规。
- 处理关切或投诉，并适当将问题上报给专业工作人员。

2. 行政支持
- 完成日常办公室任务，包括管理记录（数字和纸质）、处理学生协议和跟踪库存。
- 协助一般办公室职责，如归档、数据输入、扫描和处理文书工作。
- 在外观、行为和沟通方面保持专业性。
- 负责任地使用HDP系统和平台；保护登录凭据和机密数据。

3. 入住与住房运营
- 支持入住和退房流程，包括协助办理入住和退房手续。
- 通知室友新入住情况，并根据需要传达住房更新信息。
- 协助住房开放/关闭流程，并与设施和保洁人员保持沟通。
- 及时向相关人员报告维护或保洁问题。

4. 潜在学生招生与外联
- 为潜在学生和家庭提供住房设施参观。
- 在校园活动中代表HDP（例如，迎新、摆摊和招生活动）。
- 通过分享住房信息和促进与潜在校内住宿者的积极互动，支持招生举措。
- 偶尔参与非工作时间或周末的招生和外联活动。
jobs.responsibilities_en:
1. Customer Service & Front Desk Support
- Provide high-level, friendly, and informative customer service to students, families, and visitors.
- Respond to housing-related emails and phone calls professionally and efficiently.
- Maintain knowledge of HDP policies, housing processes, move-in/out timelines, and FERPA regulations.
- Address concerns or complaints and escalate issues appropriately to professional staff.

2. Administrative Support
- Complete day-to-day office tasks, including managing records (digital and paper), processing student agreements, and tracking inventory.
- Assist with general office duties such as filing, data entry, scanning, and processing paperwork.
- Maintain professionalism in appearance, behavior, and communication.
- Use HDP systems and platforms responsibly; protect login credentials and confidential data.

3. Occupancy & Housing Operations
- Support move-in and move-out procedures, including assisting with check-in and check-out processing.
- Notify roommates of new move-ins and communicate housing updates as needed.
- Assist with housing opening/closing processes and maintain communication with facilities and custodial staff.
- Report maintenance or custodial concerns promptly to appropriate personnel.

4. Prospective Student Recruitment & Outreach
- Conduct tours of housing facilities for prospective students and families.
- Represent HDP at campus events (e.g., orientations, tabling, and admissions events).
- Support recruitment initiatives by sharing housing information and facilitating positive interactions with prospective on-campus residents.
- Participate in occasional after-hours and weekend recruitment or outreach events.

该岗位属于犹他大学公共安全部。部门由大学首席安全官兼公共安全主任管理，下设大学警察、校园安保、UHealth 安保、应急管理、应急通信和首席安全官行政办公室等业务部门。
jobs.job_summary_en:
Performs a wide variety of law enforcement functions, including but not limited to: Utilizes proper skills to ensure the safety and security of people, property, and equipment throughout the University community. This part-time position is utilized for traffic control and other police related services at special events such as: football, basketball, concerts, and others.

Safety is a top priority for the University of Utah. The Chief Safety Officer ( CSO ) for the University is the Director of Public Safety and serves as chief of police services. The CSO is responsible for overseeing the University’s Department of Public Safety, which includes the following operational divisions: University Police, Campus Security, UHealth Security, Emergency Management, Emergency Communications, and the central administrative Office of the CSO .

Safety looks and feels different to each person, and the U Department of Public Safety is committed to working with the community to foster a safe environment where all individuals feel empowered and equipped to succeed in their work, education, and other business with the university.

More at publicsafety.utah.edu.
jobs.minimum_qualifications_zh: 犹他州邮政执法官员（LEO）认证；目前受雇于犹他州内的某个执法机构，且该机构与犹他大学公共安全部签有谅解备忘录，以协助犹他大学的特别活动；美国公民、美国国民或美国合法永久居民，且满足以下条件：1. 在申请之日前的五年内一直合法居住在美国；2. 拥有在美国工作的合法授权；在聘用之日需获得有效的犹他州驾驶执照；具备相当的人际关系和沟通技巧；合格的申请人必须成功完成部门批准的执法官员就业验证。

jobs.responsibilities_zh:
- 警员将根据其所属部门的政策和程序，为犹他大学的活动提供警务服务。警员将接受必要的培训和/或简报，包括活动的期望和职责。警务服务可能包括以下任何一项：
- 响应紧急和非紧急呼叫，如盗窃、事故、袭击。提供援助，评估并酌情处理情况；根据需要撰写书面报告以支持犹他大学警察局。应尽可能使用随身摄像头录像，犹他大学警察局记录部门将要求提供这些录像。
- 通过应用专业技能、收集证据和保护犯罪现场，进行或协助刑事、毒品、交通和帮派相关调查。
- 通过从其他执法机构、线人或公众收集信息，协助犯罪情报行动，以提供确凿的事实。
- 协助初步报告，准备书面报告，并维护详细准确的记录，用于档案、后续调查和法庭用途。
- 在高风险或已知犯罪区域进行监视，以逮捕参与犯罪活动的嫌疑人。
- 可能协助采访证人或嫌疑人以获取相关信息。
- 案件协助可能包括协助盐湖县地区检察官；在法庭上作证并提供证据。
- 协助交通管制。
- 协助活动和场地安全及特定地点，入口安检，并在需要时支持其他合同保安或大学员工进行活动运营。
- 使用和维护由所属机构或大学提供的设备。
- 运用逻辑和推理独立做出关键决策，并在各种警务职能中运用主动性和常识。
- 警员必须安全地实施强制逮捕，安全控制战斗人员，响应紧急情况，在长时间、高要求和压力大的环境中保护并确保犹他大学学生、员工、教师和访客的安全。
jobs.responsibilities_en:
- Officers will provide police services to University of Utah events in-line with their own employing department policy and procedure. Officers will be trained and/or briefed on necessary information including expectations and job functions for the event. Police services could include any of the following:
- Responds to emergency and non-emergency calls, i.e., thefts, accidents, assaults. Gives assistance, assesses, and remedies the situation as appropriate; files a written report as needed to support University of Utah Police. Body worn camera footage should be utilized whenever possible, and it will be requested by UUPD records.
- Conducts or assists in criminal, narcotics, traffic, and gang related investigations by applying specialized skills, gathering evidence, and protecting the crime scene.
- Assists the criminal intelligence operation by gathering information from other law enforcement agencies, confidential informants, or the general public to provide substantiated facts.
- Assists with initial reports, prepares written reports, and maintains detailed and accurate records for files, follow-up investigations, and court purposes.
- Performs surveillance in high risk or known crime areas in order to apprehend suspects involved in criminal activity.
- May assist with interviews of witnesses/suspects to acquire relevant information.
- Assistance on cases may include assistance for the Salt Lake County District Attorney; testifying and giving evidence in court.
- Assistance with traffic control
- Assistance with event and venue security and specific locations, screening at entrances, and supporting other contract security/University employees with event operations as needed.
- Uses and maintains equipment provided by employing agency or University
- Uses logic and reasoning to independently make critical decisions, and uses initiative and common sense in a variety of police functions.
- Officers must safely effect forcible arrest(s), safely control combatant(s), respond to emergencies, protect and ensure the safety of University students, staff, faculty and visitors while working extended hours in demanding and stressful environments.

jobs.preferences_en: - Bachelor’s degree in Criminology, Police Science, or a related area, or equivalency

jobs.responsibilities_en:
Visitor Engagement : Greet and direct visitors, conduct thorough intakes to connect them with appropriate NETE resources and staff (scheduling, internal communication, phone support).

Reception & Information : Serve as the primary point of contact via phone and desk, providing accurate information and excellent customer service.

Space Stewardship: Maintain a welcoming, accessible, and professional NETE environment through regular tidying and organization.

Resource Management: Develop and update physical and digital resources (bulletin boards, displays, Campus Connect, university calendar, etc.) to keep visitors informed.

Program Support: Assist in the planning, promotion (marketing, graphic design), and execution of NETE programs.

Initiative Promotion: Actively support and stay informed about all NETE initiatives, including tabling events.

Data & Reporting: Perform weekly data entry for impact reporting purposes.

Event Assistance: Provide comprehensive support for NETE events (sign-in, facilitation, setup/takedown, photography).

Media Management: Organize and archive event-related media (photos, videos).

Logistical Support: Assist with mail and deliveries across campus.

Team Collaboration: Participate in shared evening work responsibilities for extended NETE hours and events.

Guest Coordination: Support and coordinate guest visits (parking, directions, communication).

General Assistance: Provide support to staff members with various tasks as needed.

Professional Development: Attend weekly staff meetings as your schedule allows.

jobs.job_summary_en: The Office for Sustainability Education seeks a SCIF Sustainability Ambassador to help promote sustainability education at the University of Utah. The office mission is to empower students, employees, and the broader community through education, engagement, and collaborative action to build a sustainable future. Sustainability Ambassadors are critical to the advancement of the office mission and achieving University targets for climate action. The Sustainable Campus Initiative Fund ( SCIF ) Sustainability Ambassador will work independently and collaboratively with our team of faculty, staff, and student employees. Ambassadors are integral to the success of our office and programs like SCIF . Sustainability Ambassadors learn professional skills and grow their understanding of sustainability at the University of Utah. Funding is available to pursue professional development. This position is open to all majors. This position is work-study eligible but work-study participation is not required.

岗位可帮助学生积累专业技能并深入了解犹他大学的可持续发展工作，另有经费支持职业发展。所有专业的学生均可申请；符合勤工助学条件者可以使用该资格，但并非必须。
jobs.job_summary_en: The Office for Sustainability Education seeks a Applied Learning Sustainability Ambassador to help promote sustainability education at the University of Utah. The office mission is to empower students, employees, and the broader community through education, engagement, and collaborative action to build a sustainable future. Sustainability Ambassadors are critical to the advancement of the office mission and achieving University targets for climate action. The Applied Learning Sustainability Ambassador will work independently and collaboratively with our team of faculty, staff, and student employees. Ambassadors are integral to the success of our office and programs like curricular course funding, the sustainability learning assessment, and SCIF . Sustainability Ambassadors learn professional skills and grow their understanding of sustainability at the University of Utah. Funding is available to pursue professional development. This position is open to all majors. This position is work-study eligible but work-study participation is not required.
jobs.minimum_qualifications_zh: 该职位面向所有专业开放；该职位符合勤工助学资格，但参与勤工助学并非必需。
jobs.responsibilities_zh:
职责可能包括：

1. 协助项目的开发、执行与评估。

2. 代表办公室出席公共活动，并支持参与工作，包括后勤、摆摊及其他外联活动。

3. 为项目活动和倡议撰写书面及数字营销内容。

4. 履行行政职责，包括接待访客、接听电话和回复电子邮件咨询、安排预约、数据录入、项目研究、跑腿及处理邮件。

5. 维护办公区域和存储空间；维护办公设备的服务和供应品，以及日常办公运作。

6. 参加会议和专业发展机会。

7. 分配的其他任务。
jobs.responsibilities_en:
Responsibilities may include:

1. Assist in program development, execution and evaluation.

2. Represent the office at public events and support engagement efforts including logistics, tabling and other outreach.

3. Develop written and digital marketing content for program events and initiatives.

4. Perform administrative duties including greeting visitors, answering phone and email inquiries, scheduling appointments, data entry, project research, errands, and processing mail.

5. Maintain office areas and storage; maintain service and supplies of office equipment and general office operations.

6. Participating in meetings and professional development opportunities.

7. Other tasks as assigned.

Events generally are held in the evenings and on weekends occasionally. The selected candidate would be required to work generally between the hours of 4:00 pm and 11:00 pm but hours could vary. jobs.work_schedule_summary_zh: 被选中的候选人将被聘用，协助活动准备和后勤工作，包括活动布置、活动结束后的拆除和清理，并在活动期间提供人员支持。活动通常在晚上举行，偶尔在周末。被选中的候选人通常需要在下午4点至晚上11点之间工作，但工作时间可能有所变化。日程安排将提前两周通知实习生，但在繁忙时段，可能会临时请求协助。实习生通常需要每周工作5-10小时。
jobs.job_summary_zh:
商业、健康与繁荣中心位于 Impact & Prosperity Epicenter，Prosperity U 是其面向学生的项目，关注社区经济、社会和个人福祉。学年内会举办嘉宾讲座、社区和社交活动、读书会、音乐会、志愿服务等活动。

实习生负责活动准备和现场执行，包括布置、撤场、清洁及活动期间的人员支持。活动通常在晚间举行，偶尔安排在周末；一般工作时段为 16:00 至 23:00，具体时间会变化。排班通常提前两周通知，繁忙时期也可能临时请求协助。每周通常工作 5 至 10 小时。
jobs.job_summary_en:
The Center for Business, Health, and Prosperity advances societal prosperity by integrating value-creating business innovation with health enabling practices. The Center is housed at the Impact & Prosperity Epicenter, a living-learning community that is home to students and professionals dedicated to a shared vision for the betterment of people and the planet. The Center is seeking a motivated and outgoing student intern to assist with Prosperity U programming in the 26-27 academic year. Prosperity U is a transformative student experience focused on improving economic, social, and personal well-being across communities. Prosperity U hosts many events throughout the academic year including a speaker series, community and social events, book clubs, concert series, service projects, and other activities.

The selected candidate will be hired to assist with event preparation and logistics including event set up, event breakdown and clean up, and provide staffing support during events. Events generally are held in the evenings and on weekends occasionally. The selected candidate would be required to work generally between the hours of 4:00 pm and 11:00 pm but hours could vary. Schedules would be communicated to intern 2 weeks in advance, but assistance could be requested on short notice during busy times. Interns will be required to work 5-10 hours per week generally.

jobs.work_schedule_summary_zh: 早班或下午班，偶尔有晚间和周末班。
jobs.job_summary_zh:
Prosperity U 招聘一名学生社交媒体实习生，每周最多工作 20 小时，负责各平台内容的管理、制作、互动和数据跟踪。

实习生协助制定并执行 Prosperity U 活动和项目的营销方案，管理社交媒体内容、协调活动宣传并记录现场亮点。需要到现场收集传播素材，并参加部分活动。每学期至少要报道 CBHP 各社区的两场活动，参加所有 Prosperity U 活动和指定的 Interfaith U 活动；预先安排的发帖偶尔需要周末工作。岗位要求在 Impact and Prosperity Epicenter 的中心办公室现场办公。

该岗位可积累社交媒体营销和活动推广经验，建立专业作品集，并接触 Prosperity U 及相关社区的人脉。
jobs.job_summary_en:
Prosperity U is seeking a highly motivated and creative student to work up to 20 hours/week as a Social Media Intern. This role will be responsible for managing, creating, engaging with, and tracking content across all platforms.

The Social Media Intern will assist in creating and executing marketing strategies to promote Prosperity U events and initiatives. This role involves managing social media content, coordinating event marketing efforts, and capturing event highlights to showcase successes. The ideal candidate is creative, detail-oriented, and passionate about digital engagement.

Intern will be expected to visit onsite activities to gather materials needed for communication channels, as well as attend some events in person.

Flexibility:

Must be available to showcase at least two events per semester for each CBHP Community. Attend all Prosperity U events, and select Interfaith U events. Occasional weekend work may be required for pre-planned or scheduled postings (e.g., renewing a story to maintain engagement).

This does not include events hosted by external partners utilizing CBHP space. This position is required to work in the Center for Business, Health, and Prosperity offices in the Impact and Prosperity Epicenter.

Benefits of this role:
- Hands-on experience in social media marketing and event promotion.
- Opportunity to build a professional portfolio.
- Networking within Prosperity U and related communities.
jobs.minimum_qualifications_zh: 必须能够每学期为每个CBHP社区展示至少两个活动；参加所有Prosperity U活动和部分Interfaith U活动；可能需要偶尔在周末工作，以进行预先计划或安排的发布；该职位要求在Impact and Prosperity Epicenter的商业、健康与繁荣中心办公室工作；具备社交媒体营销和活动推广的实践经验。
jobs.responsibilities_zh:
社交媒体管理与内容创作
- 在CBHP领导指导下，策划、起草并安排吸引人的社交媒体内容。
- 通过活动前帖子推广即将举行的活动和倡议。
- 通过摄影捕捉活动亮点，并创建展示成功的活动后内容。
- 积极与其他U账户互动，建立关系，并增加Prosperity U的社交媒体关注度。
- 支持数字和实体活动宣传材料的制作。

活动营销执行
- 协调校园和Epicenter的营销工作（传单、A型架海报）。
- 支持Interfaith U、Prosperity U、主题社区的营销活动。
- 确保活动前推广、活动报道（照片/视频）和活动后总结的及时执行。
- 与员工顾问合作分配任务并维持工作流程。
- 分配的其他职责。

绩效指标
- 每周社交媒体帖子数量（包括活动推广和成功亮点）。
- 每周参与度指标：点赞、分享和评论。
- 每周社交媒体关注者增长。
- 满足既定截止日期。
jobs.responsibilities_en:
Social Media Management & Content Creation
- Curate, draft, and schedule engaging social media content under CBHP leadership direction
- Promote upcoming events and initiatives through pre-event posts.
- Capture event highlights via photography and create post-event content showcasing successes.
- Actively engage with other U accounts to build relationships and build Prosperity U’s social following.
- Support in the creation of digital and physical event collateral.

Event Marketing Execution
- Coordinate on-campus and Epicenter marketing efforts (flyers, A-frame posters).
- Support marketing campaigns for Interfaith U, Prosperity U, Theme-based communities.
- Ensure timely execution of pre-event promotions, event coverage (photos/videos), and post-event summaries.
- Collaborate with staff advisors to assign tasks and maintain workflow.
- Other duties as assigned.

Performance Metrics
- Number of social media posts per week (including event promotions and success highlights).
- Weekly engagement metrics: likes, shares, and comments.
- Growth in social media followers per week.
- Meeting stated deadlines.
jobs.preferences_zh: 较强的沟通和写作能力。熟悉社交媒体平台（Instagram、Facebook、LinkedIn等）。理想的申请者应为大二或大三学生，有管理公开Instagram账号的经验。具备基本的摄影、文案撰写和平面设计技能（视频编辑能力为加分项）。能够独立工作并按时完成任务。
jobs.preferences_en: Strong communication and writing skills. Familiarity with social media platforms (Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, etc.) The ideal applicant would be a second or third year student who has some experience managing a public Instagram account. Basic photography, copy writing, and graphic design skills (video editing also a plus). Ability to work independently and meet deadlines.

jobs.title_zh: 国际学生与学者服务同伴助理
jobs.department_zh: 国际学生与学者服务中心
jobs.work_schedule_summary_en: Must be available to work up to 15 hours a week in between regular business hours, 8am-5 pm, Monday through Friday. Occasional work on evenings/weekends and over academic breaks may be required. Availability for one year is required (spring, summer, fall semesters). Our team will work with your schedule to accommodate classes and other commitments.
jobs.work_schedule_summary_zh: 必须在正常工作时间内（周一至周五，上午8点至下午5点）每周工作最多15小时。偶尔可能需要在晚上/周末以及学术假期工作。需要保证一年的可用时间（春季、夏季、秋季学期）。我们的团队将根据您的日程安排来协调课程和其他承诺。
jobs.job_summary_zh:
国际学生与学者服务办公室（ISSS）招聘一名友好、有同理心且积极的同伴助理，为犹他大学国际学生和学者提供支持。主要工作是在办公室接待并登记前来咨询的国际学生，通过电子邮件和电话回答基础问题，同时为 ISSS 的咨询及项目人员提供一般行政和项目支持。

申请人应主动、细致，重视顾客服务、团队建设和同伴指导，并能与不同文化背景的学生沟通。在校国际学生或有海外学习、生活经历者优先。
jobs.job_summary_en:
The International Student & Scholar Services office is looking for a friendly, empathetic, and upbeat Peer Assistant to support the University of Utah’s international community. The primary responsibilities of the Peer Assistant are to be the face of the ISSS team, greeting and checking in international students as they enter the office for advising appointments and answering basic questions over email and telephone. The Peer Assistant will also provide general administrative and program support to our ISSS advising and program staff.

Our goal is to recruit qualified candidates who can contribute to the excellence and broad scope of the academic community and engage students from a variety of cultural backgrounds. Candidates who have a high level of initiative, attention to detail, and a passion for customer service, team building, and mentoring are encouraged to apply. Current international students or students who have studied/lived abroad are preferred.
jobs.minimum_qualifications_zh: 未提供明确的最低资格要求。
jobs.responsibilities_zh:
● 接待并问候学生、员工和教师。

● 及时回应访客请求，并将其需求引导至合适的团队成员或资源。

● 接听所有办公室来电，处理邮件，并管理ISSS邮箱账户。礼貌对待所有来电者/发件人。

● 安排办公室访客与ISSS工作人员和顾问之间的预约。

● 协助与其他大学部门、社区及项目合作伙伴协调活动。

● 通过维护数据库、向部门联系人发送电子邮件、扫描文件和处理电子表格，为签证相关移民文件提供支持。

● 与ISSS工作人员和同伴助理合作，全年策划并实施面向国际学生的活动，包括国际教育周和学生迎新活动。

● 准备并分发项目和办公室材料、表格及信函。

● 处理和录入数据，执行互联网搜索，并根据需要研究政策问题。

● 创建和维护ISSS文件和文件夹以用于记录保存。

● 执行ISSS团队分配的文书和行政职责。

● 分析当前趋势以确定项目的未来需求。

● 协助新员工进行项目特定培训。

● 完成分配的任何其他职责。
jobs.responsibilities_en:
● Receive and greet students, staff, and faculty.

● Respond promptly to visitor requests and direct their needs to the appropriate team member or resource.

● Answer all inbound office calls and mail as well as manage ISSS email accounts. Address all callers/senders respectfully.

● Schedule appointments between office visitors and the ISSS staff and advisors.

● Help coordinate activities with other university departments, communities, & program partners.

● Provide support for visa-related immigration documents by maintaining databases, sending emails to department contacts, scanning

documents and processing E-Forms.

● Work with ISSS staff and peer assistants to plan and implement events for international students throughout the year, including international education week and student orientation.

● Prepare and distribute program and office materials, forms, and correspondence.

● Process and enter data, perform internet searches, and research policy issues as needed.

● Create and maintain ISSS files and folders for record keeping purposes.

● Perform clerical and administrative duties as assigned by the ISSS Team.

● Analyze current trends to determine future needs for programs.

● Assist new hires with program-specific training.

● Any other duties as assigned.
jobs.preferences_zh:
- 现为犹他大学学生。
- 具备工作所需的英语熟练度。
- 守时，能够按分配的时段到岗工作。
- 客户服务技能——以友好、乐于助人的方式识别客户需求并提出解决方案。
- 跨文化能力——能迅速与来自不同文化背景的人建立联系，个性化互动，并专业地处理文化敏感情况。
- 同理心——让访客感到被倾听，预见其需求，并尽可能使他们的访问有价值。
- 书面和口头沟通技能——积极倾听访客关切，以清晰简洁的方式呈现复杂信息。
- 人际关系和团队建设技能——建立良好的工作关系，并主动支持同事。
- 组织技能——管理多项文书和行政任务，维护待办事项清单，并在最少监督下保持有序。
- 计算机技能——会使用计算机，熟悉Microsoft Office和数据录入程序（如Excel）。
- 有旅行、工作或海外生活经历。
- 展现出领导潜力和能力。
- 有为国际个人和团体提供行政、学术或客户服务支持的经验，包括辅导或指导。
- 精通英语以外的第二语言，如西班牙语、普通话、阿拉伯语、韩语或印地语。
- 了解犹他大学的部门、组织、程序以及面向学生和员工的资源。
- 对F1和J1签证移民规则有一定了解。
jobs.preferences_en:
- Current University of Utah student.
- Working proficiency in the English language.
- Punctuality and ability to be at work for hours assigned.
- Customer Service Skills- Identifying customer needs and suggesting solutions in a friendly and helpful manner.
- Intercultural Competence – Connecting quickly with people from many different cultures, personalizing interactions, and handling culturally sensitive situations professionally.
- Empathy – Making visitors feel heard, anticipating their needs, and making their visit as valuable as possible.
- Written and Verbal Communication Skills – Actively listening to visitor concerns and presenting complex information in a clear and concise way.
- Relational and Team-Building Skills – Developing good working relationships and supporting colleagues in a proactive manner.
- Organization Skills – Managing multiple clerical and administrative tasks, maintaining a to-do list, and staying organized with minimal supervision.
- Computer Skills – Use of a computer and familiarity with Microsoft Office and data entry programs (i.e., Excel).
- Travel, work or experience living abroad.
- Emerging leadership skills and capabilities.
- Experience providing administrative, academic, or customer service support to international individuals and groups, including coaching or mentoring.
- Proficiency in a second language other than English, such as Spanish, Mandarin, Arabic, Korean, or Hindi.
- Knowledge of the University of Utah departments, organizations, procedures, and resources for students and staff.
- Some familiarity with F1 and J1 visa immigration rules.

jobs.job_summary_zh: 在建筑与规划学院（CA+P）传播助理主任的指导下，负责面向在校生、意向学生、校友和社区合作伙伴开展传播工作。主要任务包括管理 Instagram 和院系项目网站、策划传播活动、联系本地媒体、报道活动，以及为各数字渠道撰写内容。该岗位覆盖整个学年。
jobs.job_summary_en: The Social media intern is responsible for a broad range of communications designed to cultivate interest from current and prospective students, alumni, and community partners. Under the direction of CA+P Assist. Director of Communications, the intern will manage social media platforms (Instagram and unit-specific program’s website), create campaigns, design local media outreach, cover events, and write digital content for the respective channels within the unit. This role is for the full academic year.
jobs.minimum_qualifications_zh: 目前就读于犹他大学建筑与规划学院、传播学院、艺术学院或相关领域的学生。
jobs.minimum_qualifications_en: Currently enrolled University of Utah student in the College of Architecture + Planning, Communication, Arts, or a related field.
jobs.responsibilities_zh:
- 设计并维护每周内容日历，包含视听内容，利用来自各种来源的想法和资源：网站、数字和印刷媒体、线下活动、课程、信息材料和新闻稿
- 撰写创意内容（例如故事和标题），遵循所需的品牌指南和模板
- 监控社交媒体渠道，并与CA+P的传播部门协调回应用户

该项目型实习会提供数据工程、自动化和数据治理方面的实践经验，涉及结构化、半结构化数据和校级分析流程。任务可能包括开发网页抓取工具，清理、转换数据并写入关系数据库，使用 Python、SQL 等语言自动化数据流程，应用数据定义标准化和元数据管理原则，以及排查和维护数据管道与数据摄取流程。实习中还会使用项目管理、高级编程和数据可视化技能。
jobs.job_summary_en:
We seek highly motivated student pursing a degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or other relevant areas of study to help support data governance within the University Analytics and Institutional Reporting ( UAIR ) department. This opportunity will focus on data management, data governance, and reporting. The position will focus on expanding and enhancing existing code to collect, process, and integrate external data sources into institutional systems.

Skill Development

This is a project oriented internship that will provide hands-on experience in data engineering, automation, and data governance practices. Students will gain experience working with structured and semi-structured data, as well as exposure to institutional analytics workflows. The following are some of the skills that may be developed through different data governance projects:
- Develop and enhance web scraping solutions to collect data from external sources
- Clean, transform, and integrate data into relational databases
- Work with scripting and programming languages (e.g., Python, SQL ) to automate data workflows
- Understand and apply data governance principles, including data definition standardization and metadata management
- Troubleshoot and maintain data pipelines and ingestion processes

There may be other tools or processes touched on throughout the internships. The following are some examples of the skills that may be developed and utilized within this internship:
- Project management,
- Advanced relevant programming skills (i.e. Python, SQL , etc.)
- Data visualization development

The Associated Students of the University of Utah ( ASUU ) is the student government representing all 35,000+ undergraduate and graduate students. This position’s focus will be assisting the Associate Director, Student Leadership & Outreach, working with ASUU student government leaders on various student‐led initiatives, and marketing projects for ASUU .

The Student Governance and Leadership department at the University of Utah, is hiring an part-time Marketing assistant. This role will provide the Student Governance and Leadership team with a variety of services, including the coordination of and assistance with marketing campaigns both printed and digital, as well as the distribution and upkeep of advertising assets. A Marketing assistant needs to have excellent attendance and time management skills, be an efficient and productive worker, and possess professional communication skills as well as the ability to multitask.

jobs.job_summary_en:
The Student Parent Support Center provides information, support, and family resources for University students, faculty, staff, and patients. Student Parent Support Center childcare programs are NAEYC accredited and serve children birth to six years. We offer part-time and full-time programming in three campus childcare programs for students, faculty, and staff and drop-in childcare for patients visiting the three U Health Centers throughout the Salt Lake Valley. These include Campus Child Care Programs (UKids – Presidents Circle,UKids – East Village, and UKids-Guardsman Way),South Jordan Health Center Program,Farmington Health Center Program, and Sugar House Health Center Program. Multiple openings and continuous hiring.

Our teachers bring kindness, patience, and mastery to the classroom every day, fostering children’s natural curiosity to learn through play and discovery. They encourage children to be lifelong learners using our nationally recognized curriculum that promotes active learning, social, physical, verbal, and cognitive development. We invest in our teacher’s education by providing a minimum of twenty hours of annual professional development in early childhood education, Utah State Licensing rules and regulations, and NAEYC best practices. Join our team and grow with us!

jobs.responsibilities_zh:
课程、课堂管理期望与指导：

1. 始终遵守犹他州儿童保育许可法规（https://childcarelicensing.utah.gov/wp-content/uploads/2022/08/R381-100.pdf）。

2. 符合NAEYC标准（https://www.naeyc.org/sites/default/files/globally-shared/downloads/PDFs/accreditation/early-learning/standards_assessment_2019.pdf）。

3. 在课堂团队中促进领导技能，并监督课堂助理，以解读行为并确保他们与儿童进行适当的工作。

4. 为助教示范适当的行为和教学技巧。

5. 制定并实施课程计划，以刺激发展进步，并根据创造性课程发展目标、DAP指导技巧和基于游戏的学习，为婴儿、幼儿和学龄前儿童提供有目的的日常体验和动手活动。

6. 使用积极的指导技巧来尽量减少不当行为，并引导儿童以积极的方式学会适当管理自己的行为。

7. 支持员工进行以下活动：与儿童在同一视线水平在地板上玩耍；始终积极监督并维持师生比例；帮助儿童如厕，包括抱起儿童更换尿布，指导他们完成如厕训练过程（根据主班教师的指示），并洗手；清洁教室；在室内和操场之间保持安全过渡（包括全年在户外积极监督儿童）。

8. 协助儿童满足身体需求、喂养、如厕/换尿布、医疗紧急情况和其他生活技能，以提供适当的护理，并在适当的情况下促进发展。

9. 儿童的日常护理，如：喂养、换尿布、拥抱、玩耍、唱歌、交谈、抱起儿童、抱着他们，以及提供温和和养育的环境。您需要随时可用并响应儿童的个体需求。

10. 分配的其他职责。

专业性：

1. 与其他员工、家长和儿童建立并保持友好、专业和有效的工作关系。

2. 与家长和监护人合作，建立和维护关系，讨论问题，提供建议和解决日常问题的方案，并缓解担忧。

3. 以支持和合作的方式与所有员工合作。

4. 作为团队合作，保持一个愉快且美观的儿童保育环境，反映儿童的兴趣。

5. 遵循管理层（包括园长或园长指定人员）的指示。这可能包括临时变更，以确保儿童的安全和福祉。

6. 展示独立工作的能力，但愿意接受主管的指导。

7. 表现出持续的出勤和准时。

8. 负责准确记录和收集客户项目使用数据，以保持符合儿童保育许可和NAEYC的要求。

9. 行为方式符合犹他大学和NAEYC的道德行为准则 https://www.naeyc.org/sites/default/files/globally-shared/downloads/PDFs/resources/position-statements/Ethics Position Statement2011_09202013update.pdf

问题解决

幼儿教师有权制定课堂上教授的所有课程计划和课程，评估问题行为和儿童的情绪功能，并与家长/监护人讨论这些事项。他/她还评估疾病或伤害的程度，并决定适当的行动方案，例如，患有哮喘的儿童可能发作异常严重等。任职者还有权在主管缺席时运营中心，监督助教并干预以确保他们使用适当的儿童指导技巧进行互动。任何疑似虐待或忽视儿童的情况均报告给主管。

幼儿教师面临的一些挑战是教授不会说英语的学龄前儿童，同时努力克服语言和文化差异；以及处理多动症。其他问题包括家长带生病的孩子来，无法离开工作去接生病的孩子，以及当孩子生病时无法联系到家长。

备注

任职者还必须适当分发家长带来的药物给儿童，并为实地考察旅行收取费用。
jobs.responsibilities_en:
Curriculum, Classroom Management Expectations and Guidance:

1. Complies with State of Utah Child Care Licensing Regulations (https://childcarelicensing.utah.gov/wp-content/uploads/2022/08/R381-100.pdf) at all times.

2. Aligns with NAEYC Standards (https://www.naeyc.org/sites/default/files/globally-shared/downloads/PDFs/accreditation/early-learning/standards_assessment_2019.pdf).

3. Promotes leadership skills within a classroom team and oversees classroom assistants to interpret behaviors and ensure that they are working appropriately with children.

4. Models appropriate behavior and teaching techniques for teaching assistants.

5. Develop and implement lesson plans to stimulate developmental progress as well as provide intentional daily experience, and hands-on activities for infants, toddlers, and preschool children in accordance with Creative Curriculum Developmental Objectives, DAP guidance techniques, and play-based learning.

6. Use positive guidance techniques to minimize inappropriate behavior and redirect children to learn how to appropriately manage their own behavior in a positive manner.

7. Supports staff in activities such as: playing on the floor with children at their eye level; actively supervising and maintaining ratios at all times; helping children toilet including lifting children to change their diapers, guiding them through the potty training process (as directed by the lead teacher), and washing hands; cleaning the classroom; maintaining safe transitions between indoors and playground (including actively supervising children outdoors year-round)

8. Assists children with physical necessities, feeding, toileting/diapering, medical emergencies, and other life skills, to give proper care and, where appropriate, facilitate development.

9. Daily routine care of children such as: feeding, diapering, cuddling, playing, singing, talking, picking children up, holding them, and otherwise providing a gentle and nurturing environment. You will need to be available and responsive to the individual needs of children.

10. Other duties as assigned.

Professionalism:

1. Establishes and maintains friendly, professional, and effective working relationships with other employees, parents, and children.

2. Works in conjunction with parents and guardians to build and maintain relationships, discuss concerns, provide suggestions and solutions to day-to-day problems, and alleviate concerns.

3. Works in a supportive and cooperative manner with all staff

4. Work as a team to maintain a cheerful and aesthetically pleasing childcare environment that reflects the interests of the children.

5. Follows directives given by Administration, including Director or Director Designee. This may include last-minute changes to ensure the safety and well-being of children are maintained.

6. Demonstrate the ability to work independently, but show a willingness to take direction from the supervisor.

7. Demonstrates consistent attendance and punctuality.

8. Responsible for accurate record keeping and data collection of client’s program usage to maintain compliance with child care licensing and NAEYC .

9. Behaves in a manner that is aligned with University of Utah and NAEYC’s Ethical Code of Conduct https://www.naeyc.org/sites/default/files/globally-shared/downloads/PDFs/resources/position-statements/Ethics Position Statement2011_09202013update.pdf

Problem Solving

The Early Childhood Teacher has the authority to develop all lesson plans and curriculum taught in the class, assess problem behaviors, and emotional functioning of children, and discuss these matters with the parents/guardians. He/she also assesses the degree of illness, or injury and decides the proper course of action, i.e. a child with asthma who might have an unusually strong attack, etc. The incumbent also has the authority to operate the center in the absence of the Supervisor, oversee teacher aides and intervene to ensure they interact with appropriate child guidance techniques. Any suspect of child abuse, or neglect are reported to the Supervisor.

Some challenges faced by the Early Childhood Teacher are teaching non-English speaking preschoolers while trying to overcome language and culture differences; and dealing with hyper-activity disorders. Other problems are parents who bring in sick children, those who are unable to leave work to pick up sick children, and those who cannot be reached when their child is sick.

Comments

The incumbent must also distribute medication brought in by parents to children appropriately, and collect money for field trips.

jobs.job_summary_en:
The Part-Time/Temporary Degree Progress Specialist provides administrative and analytical curriculum and degree audit review support to the Assistant Registrar for Academic Progress. This role focuses on ensuring the accuracy and consistency of students’ academic progress through degree audits. This will include auditing student records, manually process exceptions, and identifying discrepancies using the university catalog. The Degree Progress Specialist works collaboratively with undergraduate departments, the curriculum team, and other Registrar functional areas. This position may also review and assist with Graduate School curriculum and degree audits as needed.

This position supports institutional efforts to maintain clear, well-documented, and systematized academic records, ensuring accurate data and will work with team members in the University Registrar’s Office, curriculum contacts, and other campus partners whose roles contribute to the development of the academic offerings.

Please Note: Applicants residing outside of Utah are welcome to apply. However, the employee’s work location must be approved by the University. Remote work from locations outside of Utah is subject to review and approval based on applicable employment laws, tax and payroll requirements, and business need.
jobs.minimum_qualifications_zh: 相关领域学士学位或等效学历（一年教育可替代两年相关工作经验）加一年直接相关经验。需要表现出独立工作、分析和做出与项目内容相关的决策的能力。需要强大的协调和组织能力以优先处理冲突的截止日期。还需要表现出的人际关系和有效的沟通技巧。申请人必须表现出能够履行职位描述中概述的基本职能的潜在能力。

- 维护审查期间发现的数据异常及所采取措施的记录，为用于跟踪和审计目的的共享记录做出贡献。
