- 帮助解决与课程相关的问题和差异。
- 支持与课程流程、数据质量和操作工作流程相关的持续改进工作。
- 履行分配的其他职责。
jobs.responsibilities_en:
- Assist with data and transcript analysis, including progress testing, review, reporting, and troubleshooting.
- Perform data validation and quality assurance checks on degree audit records migrated to the new degree audit system verifying program requirements, course completion, as well as manual entry of exceptions.
- Maintain records of data anomalies and actions taken during review contributing to a shared record used for tracking and auditing purposes.
- Collaborate to review and reconcile student records, including identifying records with incomplete, inconsistent, or non-standard data.
- Assist with processing exceptions, petitions, and waivers within the degree audit system.
- Assist the Senior Assistant Registrar for Graduate Records with administrative and analytical curriculum review as needed. This may include monitoring, reviewing, and updating graduate program requirements to ensure accurate content, consistent formatting, and publication across institutional platforms and websites.
- Help resolve curriculum related issues and discrepancies.
- Support continuous improvement efforts related to curriculum processes, data quality, and operational workflows.
- Performs other duties as assigned.

STEM Community Alliance Program（STEMCAP）自 2016 年起，已在犹他州北部青少年监管机构举办 1,100 多场教育工作坊和实践保护项目，覆盖 Provo 至 Ogden 的五个青少年中心。活动包括科学家和艺术家讲座、多日科学工作坊、艺术课程、园艺项目和实地参访。

STEMCAP 与科学、艺术及人文学科专家合作，帮助被监管青少年了解不同的职业和学业方向，并提供探索兴趣和进行创作的机会。项目助理需要在青少年中心策划、带领并参与活动，维护校内外合作关系，与团队共同设计教育内容、评估材料需求并协助收集数据。
jobs.job_summary_en:
Since 2016, the STEM Community Alliance Program ( STEMCAP ) has provided more than 1,100 educational workshops and hands-on conservation projects at Youth-in-Custody facilities across northern Utah. STEMCAP offers a variety of programming types including guest lectures led by scientists and artists, multi-day science workshop series, art enrichment classes, horticulture projects, and field trips. This work occurs across five youth centers, from Provo to Ogden.

STEMCAP partners with experts in Science, the Arts, and the Humanities to increase awareness of and interest in various career and academic pathways for incarcerated youth. STEMCAP enhances educational self-discovery and provides creative outlets for youth participants. The STEMCAP Program Coordinator will create, lead, and join programming at youth centers. They will support partnerships across and beyond University of Utah’s campus. With the team, they will develop educational programming, advise material needs, and support data collection.

jobs.responsibilities_en:

本岗位隶属于中心的 Basic Needs Collective。健康资源推广大使（WEA）由学生担任，负责帮助同学了解并使用校园资源，支持他们在犹他大学顺利学习和生活，同时鼓励自己和同伴养成更健康的生活方式。
jobs.job_summary_en:
The Center for Campus Wellness ( CCW ) is a comprehensive wellness office that provides wellness education, trainings and workshops, victim-survivor advocacy services and support, safer sex services for students, collegiate recovery program, basic needs support, wellness coaching, and peer mentorship.

We are hiring student staff who will serve as a Wellness Exchange Ambassador ( WEA ) with our Basic Needs Collective. WEAs are a committed group of students who understand the importance of health and wellness, the value of connecting students to resources on campus to be successful while at the U, and who want to empower themselves and their peers to make positive changes.

Scheduling Expectations

Beginning in Fall semester through December 10 (last day of classes for Fall semester), WEAs are expected to work 10-12 hours per week. These hours may be held during regular business hours (8-5, M-F) but will also include evening or weekend events/programs. WEAs will not be required to work during academic breaks (fall, winter, spring), University closure days or holidays when Student Affairs is closed, or during finals week for the fall or spring semester. Position may be renewed for Spring and/or Summer 2027 based on program needs and available funding.

Mandatory Training (Paid)
- Upon hire, training will be provided during the first week.
- Complete Food Handler’s in first two weeks of hire.
- Complete Driving Safety Course within the first two weeks of hire.
- Complete Golf Cart driving training.
- Valid Utah driver’s license.

jobs.responsibilities_en:

9. Collaboration: Collaborate with other campus organizations, student groups, and university staff to foster a supportive campus environment.

10. Light reception duties as needed

jobs.responsibilities_en:
- Coordinate daily shipping and receiving operations during assigned shifts.

- Prepare outgoing shipments, including packaging, labeling, documentation, and carrier coordination.

Shipping / Receiving Clerk, I

Perform physical and clerical tasks associated with shipment and reception of supplies and finished products. Verify shipping records and correct packaging and labeling. Unpack received goods and check for damage and accuracy of shipment. Work with materials transport companies. Performs routine tasks as directed and under close supervision.

Requires little to no related experience.

This is an Entry-Level position in the Support track.

Job Code: S23461

Shipping / Receiving Clerk, II

Perform physical and clerical tasks associated with shipment and reception of supplies and finished products. Verify shipping records and correct packaging and labeling. Unpack received goods and check for damage and accuracy of shipment. Work with materials transport companies. Completes routine tasks under moderate supervision.

Requires at least 1 year of related experience.

This is an Intermediate Level position in the Support track.

jobs.job_summary_en:

As the Official Retailer of the University of Utah, the Campus Store serves thousands of fans through event-based merchandise locations featuring officially licensed apparel, gifts, and accessories.

Working alongside the Concessions Manager, this position assists with merchandise transportation, event setup, sales operations, inventory management, customer service, and event teardown. This is a year-round, variable-hour position with the majority of hours occurring during football season. During home football game weeks, employees may work up to 40 hours per week, including evenings, weekends, and late-night event operations. During football away weeks, bye weeks, and non-football seasons, employees should expect approximately 20 hours per week while supporting other University of Utah athletic events and special events.

This position offers opportunities for increased responsibility and advancement within Campus Store event operations, including lead event assignments, independent management of merchandise locations, and expanded operational responsibilities.

Why Work at the University Campus Store?

Employee discounts on Campus Store merchandise

Opportunities for career growth and advancement within the store

jobs.job_summary_zh: CLASP Collaborative 招聘最多两名本科生研究助理，参与由部落知识传承者、原住民教育者、中小学教师、设计师和研究人员共同开展的项目。团队通过交互式学习体验保存和传播文化、故事与语言，研究助理将参与数据收集与分析，并可能协助工作坊、交互技术设计和课程开发。
jobs.job_summary_en:
Project Description

The CLASP Collaborative is inviting up to two undergraduate research assistants to join our team. Dr. Breanne Litts (Associate Professor in Division of Games and Director of the LED Lab) will serve as primary supervisor alongside undergraduate peers, graduate students, and community educators who will also provide training and mentorship. As a community of local Tribal Knowledge Holders, Native Educators, K-12 Educators designers and researchers, our work focuses on creating interactive learning experiences that share and preserve culture, stories, and language. This interdisciplinary initiative brings together history, science, math, art, and technology and integrates a range of topics including outdoor/environmental education, place-based learning, culturally sustaining/revitalizing design, designing new technologies, storytelling or narrative, civic engagement, and language revitalization.
jobs.minimum_qualifications_zh: CLASP Collaborative 正在邀请最多两名本科生研究助理加入我们的团队；主要导师为 Breanne Litts 博士（游戏部门副教授、LED 实验室主任），同时还有本科生同伴、研究生和社区教育者提供培训和指导；作为由当地部落知识持有者、原住民教育者、K-12 教育者、设计师和研究者组成的社区，我们的工作重点是创造互动学习体验，以分享和保存文化、故事和语言；该跨学科项目融合了历史、科学、数学、艺术和技术，并整合了户外/环境教育、基于地方的学习、文化可持续/振兴设计、新技术设计、讲故事或叙事、公民参与和语言振兴等一系列主题；本科生研究助理将与学者、教育者和社区成员组成的团队合作，完成数据收集和分析等研究任务；根据经验和兴趣，可能有机会参与工作坊促进、设计互动技术和学习体验，以及为课堂和社区教育开发课程；申请此职位需提供求职信（说明您与项目相关的经验和专长）和简历或 CV；我们将立即开始面试，直至职位招满。
jobs.responsibilities_zh: 本科研究助理将与学者、教育工作者和社区成员组成的团队合作，完成数据收集和分析等研究职责。根据经验和兴趣，可能有机会参与工作坊主持、设计互动技术和学习体验，以及为课堂和社区教育开发课程。

The UMFA is housed in the award-winning Marcia and John Price Museum Building.

jobs.job_summary_en:
The Utah Museum of Fine Arts ( UMFA ) Protection Services seeks a highly motivated and dependable individual to support the team while working in an energetic and collaborative environment.

The UMFA is the state and the University fine arts museum, serving as a vital cultural resource for Utah and the broader region. Established in 1914, the Museum stewards an encyclopedic collection of more than 22,000 objects representing 5,000 years of human creativity across the globe. Through its exhibitions, programs, and collections, the UMFA advances understanding of the visual arts and their role in shaping and reflecting the human experience.

Protection Services is responsible for protecting the art and delivering excellent customer service while making sure all policies and procedures are followed by visitors, staff, volunteers, and colleagues.

jobs.responsibilities_zh:
建筑安全与安保：通过锁门和开门、在非工作时间关闭灯光和电气设备，并采取预防措施以尽量减少危险，确保UMFA建筑安全，防止盗窃和财产损失。确保客人理解并遵守博物馆规则，以保护UMFA的藏品。

巡逻与监控：定期对UMFA进行巡逻，检查门窗和受控空间，以检查藏品损坏、建筑维护需求以及环境的任何其他变化。摄像头和安防系统监控也是日常监控的一部分。

应急响应与支持：在紧急情况下协助消防部门和急救人员，包括为进入而解锁建筑、帮助人群控制、实施急救，并在必要时联系大学警察。

客户服务与社区支持：与其他前台团队、管理层和公众密切合作，确保所有UMFA访客获得安全、友好和欢迎的体验，营造协作和积极的氛围。

日志维护与事件报告：准确维护安全活动和事件的日志，向部门负责人报告潜在的安全问题，并向大学警察报告任何非法行为。
jobs.responsibilities_en:
Building Security and Safety: Secure UMFA buildings to prevent theft and property damage by locking and unlocking doors, turning off lights and electrical devices after hours, and applying preventive measures to minimize hazards. Ensure guests understand and follow museum rules to protect the UMFA’s collection.

Patrols and Surveillance: Conduct regular patrols of the UMFA , inspecting doors, windows, and controlled spaces to check for damage to the collection, building maintenance needs, and any other changes to the environment. Camera and security systems monitoring is also a part of daily surveillance.

Emergency Response and Support: Assist the Fire Department and First Responders during emergencies by unlocking buildings for entry, helping with crowd control, applying first-aid, and contacting University Police when necessary.

Customer Service and Community Support: Work closely with other front of house teams, management, and the public to ensure a secure, friendly, and welcoming experience for all visitors to UMFA , fostering a collaborative and positive atmosphere.

Log Maintenance and Incident Reporting: Maintain accurate logs of security activities and incidents, report potential security issues to department heads, and any illegal behavior to University Police.

_The Utah Museum of Fine Arts is located on the campus of the University of Utah and offers visitors the opportunity to explore over 5,000 years of human creativity with a collection of over 22,000 objects and art works from classic Greek and Roman antiquities to cutting-edge, contemporary art. Tasks will include data entry and data clean-up in Excel and in our Collections Management Database System, EMu. Tasks will also include scanning physical records and making them digital records. As part of our Digitization Initiative, our goal is to link all digital fossil records to their digital accession record i.e. the date they were collected, acquired, etc. This requires a deep dive into our legacy records and working side by side with our Paleontology Collections Manager, Head Registrar, and our Collections Digitization Coordinator.

The Assistant is part of the Museum’s Education and Community Engagement team, helping to deliver education programs that make science accessible and exciting, while providing opportunities to engage in authentic science and critical thinking. At our core, we value inquiry, collaboration, continual improvement, and community.

As an Outreach Assistant, you will work closely with the Community Engagement and Outreach Coordinator to develop and post content on our social media platforms, following our established communications plan. You will be expected to attend weekly meetings with the Community Engagement and Outreach Coordinator and complete tasks according to the communications plan. This position is hybrid, appointed by semester, and will require 10-15 hours of labor per week at $18/hour.

jobs.job_summary_en:
The College of Social Work is seeking an instructor to teach one to two courses in the BSW and/or MSW programs per semester. While instructors ordinarily teach only one course per semester, this may vary depending on the program’s needs.

The courses taught in the BSW program range from Introduction to Social Work; Social Diversity; HBSE ; Social Determinants of Health; Micro-, Mezzo-, and Macro Social Work Practice; Research and Evaluation; Applied Social Work Statistics; Social Welfare Policy; to Substance Use Counseling.

The courses taught in the MSW program range from Social Diversity; HBSE ; DSM ; Micro-, Mezzo-, and Macro Social Work Practice; Research and Evaluation; Social Welfare Policy; to clinical modalities and specialized electives ( DBT , CBT , ACT ).

Classes are available to students in a variety of forms including in-person campus, asynchronous online-based, and live distance (Zoom). Most classes are in-person campus-based classes held/conducted one day a week at the main University of Utah campus in Salt Lake City. Online classes are held/conducted/facilitated asynchronously throughout the week via the University of Utah online system (Canvas). Live distance classes are held/conducted/facilitated one day a week at distance partner campus sites and via Zoom.

This is a one-semester assignment with possible teaching assignments in future semesters based on College needs, space, and instructor course evaluations.

An MSW with two years of practice experience relevant to the course topic, or a PhD in social work or a related field is preferred. Applicants without an MSW and two years of practice experience will be limited to teaching “non-practice” (e.g., HBSE ; Social Determinants of Health; Research and Evaluation; and Applied Social Work Statistics) related courses.

犹他大学的 TRIO 项目为过去较难获得高等教育机会的学生提供从大学准备、入学过渡到学业完成的一系列支持。TRIO Upward Bound（UB）和 TRIO Student Support Services（SSS）通过个别辅导、学业支持、课业辅导、大学与职业探索、助学金及财务知识指导等服务，帮助学生从高中阶段一直完成第一个学士学位。项目由美国教育部资助：SSS 每年获得 409,067 美元，为 225 名符合条件的犹他大学低收入、第一代大学生及／或残障学生提供服务；UB 每年获得 502,258 美元，为盐湖城都会区四所目标高中的 95 名低收入及第一代大学生提供服务。
jobs.job_summary_en:
Role Overview:

The Program Assistant will work with the Administrative Manager and Director of the TRIO Programs to help ensure that day-to-day office operations are organized, responsive, accurate, and student-centered.

The Program Assistant’s primary responsibilities include program record keeping, reception and customer service, data entry, filing and document management, preparation of materials, student communications, and general office support. As a front-line representative of TRIO , the Program Assistant greets students and visitors, responds to routine questions, appropriately routes inquiries, and helps maintain a welcoming and professional environment. Because the position may work with student records and other program information, the Program Assistant is expected to exercise discretion, accuracy, and appropriate confidentiality always.

The Program Assistant also supports outreach, recruitment, communications, and special events by assisting with tabling, orientations, resource fairs, event logistics, attendance tracking, promotional materials, newsletters, social media content, and other student-facing communications. The position provides broad operational support across TRIO Programs and contributes to the systems and services that help staff effectively serve program participants.

Program Overview:

The University of Utah’s TRIO Programs provide a comprehensive continuum of college access, preparation, transition, and academic success services designed to increase educational opportunity and postsecondary degree attainment for students who have historically faced barriers to higher education. Through TRIO Upward Bound (UB) and TRIO Student Support Services ( SSS ), the University supports students from high school through completion of their first bachelor’s degree by providing individualized advising, academic support, tutoring, college and career exploration, financial aid and financial literacy guidance, educational enrichment, and opportunities that strengthen students’ academic skills, confidence, self-advocacy, and sense of belonging. Together, the programs foster supportive and student-centered communities that empower participants to navigate educational systems, persist toward their goals, and successfully complete postsecondary education.

Funded by the U.S. Department of Education, the TRIO Student Support Services ( SSS ) program receives $409,067 annually to serve 225 eligible University of Utah students who are low-income, first-generation college students, and/or students with disabilities, while the TRIO Upward Bound (UB) program receives $502,258 annually to serve 95 low-income and first-generation students across four target high schools in the Salt Lake City metropolitan area.

jobs.job_summary_en:
The Student Engagement Assistant will work with the Program Coordinator and Manager within the TRIO -Student Support Services ( SSS ) Program to facilitate overall success and support activities within the TRIO - SSS Program.

The Student Engagement Assistant will support first-time freshman students in successfully navigating the University of Utah and building a strong sense of belonging within the SSS community. Through regular outreach and one-on-one check-ins, they provide guidance, encouragement, and referrals to campus resources while fostering meaningful connections and student success.

The Student Engagement Assistant will also help develop and facilitate workshops, coordinate community-building activities, and organize social events that promote student engagement throughout the academic year. The position also serves as an ambassador for the program by representing TRIO SSS at outreach events, tabling opportunities, orientations, and campus resource fairs to recruit and connect with prospective and current students.

Additional responsibilities include creating and managing student-facing communications, such as social media content, newsletters, the TRIO Canvas page, promotional graphics, and event marketing materials, to increase awareness of TRIO SSS programs and services. The Student Engagement Assistant also provide administrative support, assists with program operations, and contributes to the planning and implementation of initiatives that foster an engaging and supportive student experience.

Program Overview:

The University of Utah’s TRIO Student Support Services ( SSS ) program is a federally funded academic success program dedicated to helping first-generation students, students from income-eligible backgrounds, and students with disabilities successfully navigate the University and complete their first bachelor’s degree. Through individualized advising, tutoring, academic and career exploration, financial aid and financial literacy guidance, graduate school preparation, workshops, peer connections, and community-building experiences, SSS provides students with the resources, relationships, and encouragement needed to thrive. The program fosters a welcoming and student-centered learning community where participants can strengthen their sense of belonging, develop confidence and self-advocacy, overcome barriers to persistence, and achieve their educational, personal, and professional goals.

Funded by the U.S. Department of Education, the program receives $409,067 annually to serve 225 eligible University of Utah students each year.

2. Satisfactorily complete the requirements of the internship.

申请人需了解现场剧场演出的基本职责和组织方式，并具备基础摄像操作能力；能够听从指挥，在演出压力下工作，并准时参加所有技术彩排和演出。现场任务经常变化，需要同时处理多项工作、提前判断，并根据新信息及时行动。岗位也可能安排现场音响、灯光、投影及其他舞台工作。还需能够抬起或拉动至少 50 磅（约 23 公斤）的物品，并安全、谨慎地搬运较重的摄像设备及配件。
jobs.job_summary_en:
Works with the AV Room Manager, Technical Director, Production Director, and Stage Manager at the Marriott Center for Dance to work on video documentation and live-streaming during School of Dance performances.

Must have a basic knowledge of live theatrical performance responsibilities and organization structure including a basic understanding of camera operation. Must take direction well and be able to perform under pressure during a live performance setting. Must be able to attend all technical rehearsals and performances without fail or tardiness.

The crew position is continually changing so the applicant must be able to multitask and think ahead while receiving new information about actions that need to be taken. There may be opportunities in this position to work in other areas of the stage including live sound, lighting, projections, and other crew needs.

Must be able to lift or pull at least 50 lbs. and be able to move heavy camera equipment and its peripherals safely and with care.
jobs.minimum_qualifications_zh: 必须具备基本的现场戏剧表演职责和组织结构知识，包括基本的摄像机操作理解；必须能很好地接受指示，并能在现场表演环境中承受压力；必须无缺席或迟到地参加所有技术排练和演出；该 crew 职位不断变化，因此申请人必须能够同时处理多项任务并提前思考，同时接收有关需要采取行动的新信息；必须能够举起或拉动至少 50 磅的重物，并安全小心地移动重型摄像设备及其外围设备。
jobs.responsibilities_zh: 根据AV房间经理的指示而有所不同。
jobs.responsibilities_en: Varies per directions of the AV Room Manager.
jobs.preferences_zh: 有摄像和/或舞台技术方面的先前经验。
jobs.preferences_en: Prior experience with videography and/or stagecraft.

工作内容多样且经常变化，需要快速学习、提前考虑并适应新的流程和现场情况；在演出压力下能够及时执行指令。可靠出勤非常重要，必须准时参加所有技术彩排和演出。岗位还要求能够抬起或拉动至少 50 磅（约 23 公斤）的物品，并能推拉布景、吊挂设备及其他器材。
jobs.job_summary_en: Works with Production Director, Technical Director, Stage Manager, and AV Room Manager at the Marriott Center for Dance to provide production support for School of Dance performances and special events. Applicants should have a basic knowledge of live theatrical performance and an enthusiastic willingness to acquire a basic understanding of live sound, lighting, and run crew operations. The responsibilities are varied and continually changing, so stage crew members must learn quickly, think ahead, and adapt to new processes and situations. They must be able to take direction promptly and perform under pressure during live performance settings. Dependability is of utmost priority, and stage crew members must attend technical rehearsals and performances without fail or tardiness. Individuals in this position must be able to lift or pull at least 50 lbs, and push or pull set pieces, rigging, and equipment.
jobs.minimum_qualifications_zh: 与制作总监、技术总监、舞台监督和 AV 房间经理合作，为舞蹈学院的演出和特别活动提供制作支持；申请人应具备基本的现场戏剧表演知识，并热情愿意学习现场音响、灯光和运行 crew 操作的基本知识；职责多样且不断变化，因此舞台 crew 成员必须快速学习、提前思考并适应新流程和情况；必须能够迅速接受指示并在现场表演环境中承受压力；可靠性是最重要的，舞台 crew 成员必须无缺席或迟到地参加技术排练和演出；此职位人员必须能够举起或拉动至少 50 磅的重物，并推动或拉动布景、索具和设备。

- Answer inquiries that may result in a search for records

jobs.job_summary_en: This is an open position for an art model for the Department of Art and Art History. The position requires modeling for both draped and undraped poses. Poses generally span two days of class, and are each three hours long. Models are only used as needed by instructors and may only be asked to work very limited hours.
jobs.minimum_qualifications_zh: 该职位要求为艺术与艺术史系进行着衣和裸体模特摆姿；姿势通常持续两天的课程，每次三小时；模特仅按教师需要被使用，可能只被要求工作非常有限的时间；被选中的申请人将专业且守时；能够保持静止数小时是这份工作最重要的部分；您必须适应在 20 位或更多艺术家面前裸露整个姿势期间。
jobs.responsibilities_zh: 被选中的申请人将表现得专业且守时。能够静坐数小时是这份工作最重要的部分。在摆姿势期间，你必须能够坦然地在20位或更多艺术家面前裸露身体。
jobs.responsibilities_en: The chosen applicant will be professional and timely. Being able to stay still for several hours is the most important part of this job. You must be comfortable with being naked in front of 20 or more artists for the duration of the pose.
jobs.preferences_zh:
优先考虑有建模经验者，但并非必需。

欢迎所有年龄和体型的模特申请。

必须年满21岁。
jobs.preferences_en:
Prior modeling experience is preferred, but not necessary.

Models of all ages and body types are encouraged to apply.

Must be at least 21 years old.

Students may be assigned to do one or more of the following:
- Supervise the wood shop. Assist students and faculty as needed. Safety training will be required.
- Assist with daily office tasks such as scanning, sorting mail, answering phones, and helping students at the window. Will be assigned tasks as needed.
- Be an attendant at the Gittins Gallery
- Other lab monitoring may be needed depending on departmental demands

- Will have a set schedule

jobs.minimum_qualifications_zh: 高中文凭或同等学历（一年教育可替代两年相关工作经验）要求；一年全职客户服务经验或同等经验，以及表现出的人际关系和有效沟通能力也要求。申请人必须表现出能够履行职位描述中概述的基本职能的潜在能力。

High school diploma or equivalency (one year of education can be substituted for two years of related work experience) required. One year full-time customer service experience or equivalency, demonstrated human relation and effective communication skills also required.

Applicants must demonstrate the potential ability to perform the essential functions of the job as outlined in the position description.
jobs.responsibilities_zh:
- 在前台服务，作为部门的门面。以专业和热情的方式代表部门，迎接访客，处理请求。
- 维护办公空间，包括休息区和学生休息室。监督办公用品和需求。保持厨房和休息室物资充足。
- 管理部门社交媒体。与教师、职员、学生以及人文学院社交媒体协调员合作，推广活动、新闻和亮点。
- 协助职员和教师在日程安排、组织和推广部门活动方面的工作。
- 维护课程、部门会议和活动的日程。协助安排房间。
- 协助办公室组织，包括维护教师和学生信箱以及部门公告区域。确保每日收集和分发邮件。
- 回答或转发与注册、课程、教师信息、研究生招生、咨询预约等相关的问题。
- 协助教师和职员进行复印和扫描需求。监督复印机和复印室的维护。
- 与职员合作协助他们的任务。引导学生到相应的职员处。
- 愿意扩展此角色并承担新的职责，包括但不限于与会计相关的小型活动。

此职位描述并非旨在包含或解释为对该职位员工所需的所有职责、责任和资格的全面清单。

工作环境和通常需要的频率

几乎持续：办公室环境。

可能需要的身体要求和频率

几乎持续：坐、听、倾听、说话。

经常：重复性手部动作（如打字）、行走。

jobs.job_summary_en:
Join Our Team as a Work-Study Custodian!

Are you a college student looking for a part-time job that fits your academic schedule? Look no further! We’re hiring work-study custodians to help maintain a clean and safe environment on campus.

This is an entry-level position. Demonstrated human relation and effective communication skills are required. Six months of related experience is preferred.

Applicants must demonstrate the potential ability to perform the essential functions of the job as outlined in the position description.

This job posting is only available to University of Utah students who have been awarded a Federal Work-Study Award for the current year. Please login to CIS and go to the Finance/Financial Aid section to view your Financial Aid Status. If you have not received a Federal Work-Study Award, then do not complete and submit this application. Before hire, this employer will confirm that you have received a Federal Work-Study Award for the current year.
jobs.minimum_qualifications_zh: 等效声明：1年高等教育可替代1年直接相关工作经验（例如：学士学位=4年直接相关工作经验）。部门可按以下级别聘用：清洁工I：要求极少或无相关经验。部门特定资格：联邦勤工助学资格：必须符合联邦勤工助学（FWS）资助资格；可靠性：准时且可靠；独立性：能够独立工作并遵循指示；沟通技巧：较强的沟通能力为佳。

Independence: Ability to work independently and follow instructions.

jobs.responsibilities_zh:
日常清洁：扫地、拖地和除尘——您将让我们的空间保持闪亮洁净。

垃圾管理：清空垃圾桶，确保公共区域保持整洁。

活动支持：协助活动的布置和撤场——参与其中！

团队协作：与其他保洁人员一起工作，确保一切顺利进行。

注重细节的清洁：从地板到天花板，您将使用合适的用品让一切焕发光彩。

灵活的学生工作时间：我们理解您的学业承诺。我们的工作时间对您灵活安排，提供4小时轮班。

申请流程：感兴趣吗？通过我们的在线门户申请：勤工助学（Work-Study）保洁员申请。

为什么选择我们？

社区：加入一个由探索者、创新者和领导者组成的社区。

优美地点：犹他大学位于充满活力的盐湖城，周围环绕着令人惊叹的户外休闲区。

员工福利：享受免费公交卡、家庭友好的工作与生活平衡、制服、在职培训以及成长机会。

关于职位：作为勤工助学（Work-Study）保洁员，您将在校园各处提供必要的清洁服务。从教室到公共空间，您将在为每个人维护温馨环境方面发挥重要作用。

关键词：看管、看门人、清洁、保洁、保洁员

欢迎与同学们分享这个令人兴奋的机会，加入我们的团队，一起保持校园清洁和运转！

工作环境和可能需要的频率

几乎持续：办公室环境。很少：危险（包括各种物理条件，如靠近移动机械部件、移动车辆、电流、在脚手架和高处工作，或接触化学品）。

身体要求和可能需要的频率

几乎持续：坐、听、倾听、说话、行走。经常：弯腰、伸手过头、扭转。很少：举起——最多50磅，跪、蹲。
jobs.responsibilities_en:
:

Routine Cleaning: Sweeping, mopping, and dusting – you’ll keep our spaces sparkling clean.

Trash Management: Emptying trash receptacles and ensuring common areas stay tidy.

Event Support: Assist with event setup and breakdown – be part of the action!

Team Collaboration: Work alongside other custodial staff to keep things running smoothly.

Detail-Oriented Cleaning: From flooring to ceilings, you’ll use the right supplies to make everything shine.

Flexible Hours for Students: We understand your academic commitments. Our work schedule is flexible with you, with 4-hour shifts available.

Application Process: Interested? Apply through our online portal: Work-Study Custodian Application.

Why Choose Us?

Community: Join a community of explorers, innovators, and leaders.

Beautiful Location: The University of Utah is in vibrant Salt Lake City, surrounded by stunning outdoor recreation areas.

Employee Benefits: Enjoy free transit passes, family-friendly work-life balance, uniforms, on-the-job training, and growth opportunities.

About the Role: As a work-study custodian, you’ll provide essential cleaning services across campus. From classrooms to public spaces, you’ll play a vital role in maintaining a welcoming environment for everyone.

Keywords: janitorial, janitor, cleaning, custodial, custodian

Feel free to share this exciting opportunity with fellow students, and join our team to keep our campus clean and functioning together!

Work Environment and Level of Frequency that may be required

Nearly Continuously: Office environment. Seldom: Hazards (includes a variety of physical conditions, such as proximity to moving mechanical parts, moving vehicles, electrical current, working on scaffolding and high places, or exposure to chemicals). Physical Requirements and Level of Frequency that may be required Nearly Continuously: Sitting, hearing, listening, talking, walking. Often: Bending, reaching overhead, twisting. Seldom: Lifting – up to 50 pounds, kneeling, squatting.

PATHS 是面向高中生的大学预备项目，重点服务第一代大学生和低收入家庭学生。学生从升入高中前的暑假开始参加，持续到高中毕业，项目通过大学资源和学习社区帮助他们完成高中学业并为大学做好准备。

导师需要与学生建立稳定、可信的辅导关系，帮助他们完成高中学习并申请大学。主要工作包括营造支持性学习体验，协助管理课程和作业，指导时间管理与学习方法，并分享高中和大学阶段的经验与知识。
jobs.job_summary_en:
The PATHS program is a cohort-based pre-college program for high school students, especially those who are first-generation or low-income. Our goal is for students to achieve high school success and college readiness. Students participate year-round from the summer before their freshmen year of high school until graduation. The program provides access to university resources and a learning community to prepare students to pursue higher education.

PATHS is looking for mentors to be experienced and trusted advisors who form supportive, coaching relationships and assist students in completing high school and applying for college. Mentors are expected to:
- Create supportive and enriching experiences for students.
- Help students manage academics and homework.
- Guide students on time management and other study skills.
- Share advice and knowledge about high school and college.

David Eccles 商学院招聘职业发展经理兼教练，为医疗管理硕士（MHA）学生提供职业支持，并参与项目的行业合作和整体发展。

jobs.job_summary_en:
The David Eccles School of Business seeks a dynamic and experienced Career Advancement Manager & Coach to serve students in the Master of Healthcare Administration ( MHA ) program. This individual will play a central role in shaping the professional success and industry engagement of MHAstudents, while contributing to the program’s overall strategic direction and reputation.

The ideal candidate has a healthcare background and a deep understanding of healthcare organizations, talent development, and industry dynamics—coupled with expertise in career coaching, relationship management, and program leadership. They will partner with faculty, alumni, employers, and national organizations to elevate the MHA program’s visibility and outcomes, ensuring students are well-positioned for impactful careers in healthcare leadership. This role also includes employer relations, professional development programming, case competition management, and alumni engagement.

- 开发和提供关于专业技能、高管风范和医疗特定职业路径的研讨会。
- 监测职业成果，收集学生反馈，并在辅导和项目中实施持续改进。

- 建立、加强和维护与医疗组织、雇主和校友的关系，以扩大实习和全职就业机会。
- 领导并参加行业社交活动、实地考察和雇主小组讨论，将学生与现实世界的机会联系起来。
- 管理校友参与工作，鼓励在MHA社区内进行导师指导、职业小组讨论和专业社交。

职业项目与活动
- 支持MHA案例竞赛的各个方面，包括团队组建、辅导后勤、教师协调和全国竞赛参与。
- 策划和执行提升学生专业成长的活动，如招聘会和社交招待会。

Career Programming & Events
- Support all aspects of MHA case competitions, including team formation, coaching logistics, faculty coordination, and national competition participation.
- Plan and execute events that enhance student professional growth, such as career fairs and networking receptions.

Program Collaboration

jobs.responsibilities_zh:
主要职责：数据录入与CRM管理（75%的时间）：
- 潜在客户数据管理：准确地将来自多个来源的结构化潜在客户数据输入、验证并管理到Salesforce中，确保数据的完整性、一致性和可用性，以支持后续活动。
- 自动化与流程：绘制、构建、测试并优化自动化及数据工作流程，以简化流程并减少人工错误。
- 数据录入卓越：以高度精确和准确的方式将信息输入计算机信息系统。
- 验证与审查：对照源文件彻底审查和验证输入内容的准确性和完整性，并进行必要的更正。
- 文档管理：维护文档主文件以进行备份和验证，确保所有记录组织良好且最新。
- 数据报告：运行查询、验证输出并生成报告，以支持活动执行、绩效分析和决策。
- 数据质量与故障排除：识别、调查并解决系统中的数据不一致或错误；主动标记可能影响活动执行或报告准确性的上游问题。

辅助职责（25%的时间）：

- 营销分析：通过分析和指标，监测营销活动（包括电子邮件和短信活动）的有效性。
- 市场调研：进行市场调研，并推荐符合项目目标的策略、宣传材料、供应商和沟通方式。
- 网页支持：根据技能和兴趣，可能协助开发和维护网页。
- 其他职责：执行分配的其他与工作相关的任务，以支持整体营销策略。

本职位描述并非旨在包含或解释为分配给该职位的员工所需的所有职责、责任和资格的全面清单。

工作环境和频率要求

很少：弯腰、伸手过头。

最低资格

- 需要至少1年相关经验。
- 一年数据录入、数据操作或相关技术经验，或同等课程（例如，信息系统、分析、计算机科学、商业分析）。
- 熟练使用数据录入设备，并具备良好的人际关系和有效的沟通能力。
- 申请人必须展示出能够履行职位描述中概述的基本职能的潜在能力。

偏好

jobs.responsibilities_en:
Primary Responsibility: Data Entry & CRM Management (75% of Time):
- Lead Data Management: Accurately input, validate, and manage structured lead data from multiple sources into Salesforce, ensuring data integrity, consistency, and usability for downstream campaigns.
- Automation & Process Flows: Map, build, test, and refine automation and data workflows to streamline processes and reduce manual errors.
- Data Entry Excellence: Enter information into computerized information systems with a strong emphasis on precision and accuracy.
- Verification & Review: Thoroughly review and verify input against source documents for accuracy and completeness, making necessary corrections.
- Document Management: Maintain document master files for backup and verification, ensuring all records are well organized and up to date.
- Data Reporting: Run queries, validate outputs, and generate reports to support campaign execution, performance analysis, and decision-making.
- Data Quality & Troubleshooting: Identify, investigate, and resolve data inconsistencies or errors across systems; proactively flag upstream issues that could impact campaign execution or reporting accuracy.

Supporting Responsibilities (25% of Time):
- Administrative Support: Provide general support to the Marketing team. May also involve limited administrative or clerical support as needed; priority is given to data accuracy, systems support, and marketing operations.
- Marketing Analytics: Analyze and monitor the effectiveness of marketing efforts, including email and text message campaigns, through analytics and metrics.
- Market Research: Conduct market research and recommend strategies, promotional materials, vendors, and communication methods that align with program goals.
- Web Support: Depending on skill set and interest, may aid in the development and maintenance of web pages.
- Additional Duties: Perform other job-related tasks as assigned to support the overall marketing strategy.

This job description is not designed to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities and qualifications required of employees assigned to the job.

Work Environment and Level of Frequency typically required

Nearly Continuously: Office environment.

Physical Requirements and Level of Frequency that may be required

Nearly Continuously: Sitting, hearing, listening, talking.

Often: Repetitive hand motion (such as typing), walking.

Seldom: Bending, reaching overhead.

Minimum Qualifications

EQUIVALENCY STATEMENT : 1 year of higher education can be substituted for 1 year of directly related work experience (Example: bachelor’s degree = 4 years of directly related work experience).
- Requires at least 1 year of related experience.
- One year of data entry, data operations, or related technical experience or equivalent coursework (e.g., information systems, analytics, computer science, business analytics)
- Proficiency with data entry equipment and demonstrated human relations and effective communication skills are also required.
- Applicants must demonstrate the potential ability to perform the essential functions of the job as outlined in the position description.

Preferences
- Highly detail-oriented with strong organizational skills.
- Critical thinking and problem-solving abilities, with a willingness to ask questions and suggest improvements.
- Comfortable participating in virtual meetings for training and guidance.
- Advanced Excel skills (e.g., lookups, pivot tables, structured formulas)
- Comfort working with structured or relational data
- Experience with Salesforce or other CRM systems
- Ability to work independently within systems-based workflows
- Exposure to databases, automation tools, or light scripting ( SQL , Python, R) a plus
